test_cases.title: Start of Mission tetikleyicisiyle iletişim oturumu başlatma
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, Start of Mission durumuna geçiş yapmaya hazırdır ve geçerli bir RBC kimliği yapılandırılmıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Start of Mission komutu.

steps.action: Sürücü Start of Mission işlemini başlatır.
steps.expected: OBU, SUBSET-026 §3.5.3.4'te tanımlanan tetikleyici durumuna göre bir iletişim oturumu başlatma sürecini başlatır.

test_cases.title: Ray kenarı komutu ile iletişim oturumu başlatma
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, ray kenarı ile iletişim halindedir ve geçerli bir RBC kimliği yapılandırılmıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Ray kenarından gelen geçerli bir iletişim oturumu başlatma komutu.

steps.action: Ray kenarından OBU'ya iletişim oturumu başlatma komutu gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, komutu alır ve SUBSET-026 §3.5.3.4'te tanımlanan tetikleyici durumuna göre bir iletişim oturumu başlatma sürecini başlatır.

test_cases.title: Mod değişikliği bildirimi için iletişim oturumu başlatma
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, RBC'ye bildirilmesi gereken bir mod değişikliği durumundadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Mod değişikliği tetikleyicisi.

steps.action: RBC'ye bildirilmesi gereken bir mod değişikliği gerçekleşir.
steps.expected: OBU, SUBSET-026 §3.5.3.4'te tanımlanan tetikleyici durumuna göre bir iletişim oturumu başlatma sürecini başlatır.

test_cases.title: Manuel Level 2 seviye değişikliği ile iletişim oturumu başlatma
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, Level 2 seviyesine geçiş yapmaya hazırdır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Manuel Level 2 seviye değişikliği komutu.

steps.action: Sürücü, OBU'yu manuel olarak Level 2 seviyesine geçirir.
steps.expected: OBU, SUBSET-026 §3.5.3.4'te tanımlanan tetikleyici durumuna göre bir iletişim oturumu başlatma sürecini başlatır.

test_cases.title: Güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulumu ve oturum başlatma sıralaması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, bir iletişim oturumu başlatma tetikleyicisi almıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Geçerli bir RBC kimliği ve uyumlu sistem versiyonu.

steps.action: OBU, güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulumu için istek gönderir.
steps.expected: OBU, SUBSET-026 §3.5.3.7'de tanımlanan sıralamaya göre güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulumu isteğini gönderir.

steps.action: Güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulduktan sonra OBU, iletişim oturumu başlatma mesajını gönderir.
steps.expected: OBU, 'Initiation of communication session' mesajını gönderir.

steps.action: RBC'den sistem versiyonu bilgisi alınır.
steps.expected: OBU, oturumu kurulmuş olarak kabul eder ve 'session established report' mesajını gönderir.

test_cases.title: Uyumlu sistem versiyonu yoksa oturumun sonlandırılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, bir iletişim oturumu başlatma tetikleyicisi almıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Uyumlu olmayan bir sistem versiyonu.

steps.action: OBU, güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulumu için istek gönderir ve iletişim oturumu başlatma mesajını iletir.
steps.expected: OBU, 'Initiation of communication session' mesajını gönderir.

steps.action: RBC'den uyumlu olmayan bir sistem versiyonu bilgisi alınır.
steps.expected: OBU, 'No compatible version supported' mesajını gönderir, sürücüyü bilgilendirir ve oturumu sonlandırır.

test_cases.title: Güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulumunda radyo sistemi seçimi önceliği
test_cases.preconditions: OBU'da her iki radyo sistemi de mevcuttur.
test_cases.test_inputs: Ray kenarı komutu, sürücü tercihi ve depolanan radyo ağı bilgisi.

steps.action: Ray kenarından, hedef RBC'nin FRMCS-only olduğu bir iletişim oturumu başlatma komutu gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, SUBSET-026 §3.5.3.7.1'de tanımlanan öncelik sırasına göre FRMCS radyo sistemini seçer.

steps.action: Ray kenarı komutu yoksa, sürücünün Start of Mission'da tek radyo tercihi yapılır.
steps.expected: OBU, sürücünün tercih ettiği radyo sistemini seçer.

steps.action: Sürücü tercihi yoksa, depolanan radyo ağı bilgisi ve tercih edilen radyo sistemi kullanılır.
steps.expected: OBU, depolanan radyo ağı bilgisi ve tercih edilen radyo sistemine göre seçim yapar.

test_cases.title: Başarılı radyo sistemi kurulumunun hafızaya kaydedilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU'da her iki radyo sistemi de mevcuttur ve bir iletişim oturumu başarıyla kurulmuştur.
test_cases.test_inputs: Başarılı radyo sistemi kurulumu.

steps.action: OBU, bir radyo sistemi kullanarak güvenli radyo bağlantısını başarıyla kurar.
steps.expected: OBU, hangi radyo sistemini kullandığını hafızaya kaydeder.

test_cases.title: Oturum kurulumu sırasında koşulların oluşmasıyla oturumun iptali
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, bir iletişim oturumu kurulumu sürecindedir.
test_cases.test_inputs: SUBSET-026 §3.5.3.8'de tanımlanan bir iptal koşulu (örneğin, End of Mission).

steps.action: Oturum kurulumu sırasında, SUBSET-026 §3.5.3.8'de tanımlanan bir iptal koşulu oluşur (örneğin, End of Mission).
steps.expected: OBU, oturum kurulumunu iptal eder ve güvenli radyo bağlantısını serbest bırakır.

test_cases.title: Son bilinen RBC kimliği ile iletişim oturumu başlatma
test_cases.preconditions: OBU'da depolanan RBC iletişim bilgileri mevcuttur.
test_cases.test_inputs: Ray kenarından gelen, 'son bilinen RBC' anlamına gelen özel RBC kimliği içeren bir komut.

steps.action: Ray kenarından, 'son bilinen RBC' anlamına gelen özel RBC kimliği içeren bir iletişim oturumu başlatma komutu gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, komuttaki telefon numarasını görmezden gelir ve depolanan RBC iletişim bilgilerini kullanarak RBC'ye bağlanır.

test_cases.title: Depolanan RBC bilgisi yoksa son bilinen RBC komutunun yok sayılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU'da depolanan RBC iletişim bilgileri yoktur.
test_cases.test_inputs: Ray kenarından gelen, 'son bilinen RBC' anlamına gelen özel RBC kimliği içeren bir komut.

steps.action: Ray kenarından, 'son bilinen RBC' anlamına gelen özel RBC kimliği içeren bir iletişim oturumu başlatma komutu gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, komutu yok sayar ve iletişim oturumu başlatmaz.

test_cases.title: Prevention of duplicate session establishment with same RBC
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 mode. A communication session with RBC-A is currently being established (state: Establishing).
test_cases.test_inputs: Trigger for a new session with RBC-A (e.g., manual selection of RBC contact info or trackside order).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU allows triggering session establishment via manual selection or trackside order for testing purposes.

steps.action: Initiate a new communication session request with RBC-A while the first session is still in the 'Establishing' state.
steps.expected: The OBU does not open a further communication session with RBC-A. The existing establishment process continues or fails, but no second parallel session attempt is initiated.

test_cases.title: Prevention of duplicate session establishment with same RBC after establishment
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 mode. A communication session with RBC-A is established and active. No 'Termination of Communication Session' message has been sent to RBC-A.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trigger for a new session with RBC-A (e.g., Start of Mission in Level 2 or manual level change).

steps.action: Trigger a new communication session request with RBC-A while the current session is active and not terminated.
steps.expected: The OBU does not open a further communication session with RBC-A. The existing session remains active.

test_cases.title: Termination of existing sessions when establishing new session with different RBC
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 mode. An active communication session exists with RBC-A. The OBU is capable of handling multiple sessions (or the exception condition is not met).
test_cases.test_inputs: Order to establish a session with RBC-B (e.g., RBC transition order).
test_cases.assumptions: RBC-A and RBC-B are distinct entities.

steps.action: Receive an order to establish a communication session with RBC-B.
steps.expected: The OBU terminates the existing session with RBC-A.

steps.action: Observe the session establishment process with RBC-B.
steps.expected: The OBU establishes a new communication session with RBC-B.

test_cases.title: Exception: Accepting RBC session does not terminate Supervising RBC session
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 mode. An active communication session exists with RBC-A (Supervising RBC). The OBU is capable of handling multiple communication sessions through GSM-R.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC transition order containing an embedded order to establish a session with RBC-B (Accepting RBC).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU supports multiple concurrent GSM-R sessions.

steps.action: Receive an RBC transition order that includes an instruction to establish a session with RBC-B (Accepting RBC).
steps.expected: The OBU does NOT terminate the existing session with RBC-A (Supervising RBC).

steps.action: Observe the session status.
steps.expected: Both the session with RBC-A and the new session with RBC-B are active.

test_cases.title: Evaluation of balise information validity in Sleeping mode (Nominal direction)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Sleeping (SL) mode. Train orientation is Nominal. A balise group is crossed in the Nominal direction.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise data containing: 1) Info valid for both directions, 2) Info valid for Nominal direction only, 3) Info valid for Reverse direction only.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can be forced into SL mode for testing.

steps.action: Cross the balise group in the Nominal direction while in SL mode.
steps.expected: The OBU takes into account the information valid for both directions.

steps.action: Check the status of the information valid for Nominal direction only.
steps.expected: The OBU takes into account the information valid for the crossing direction (Nominal).

steps.action: Check the status of the information valid for Reverse direction only.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the information valid only for the opposite direction (Reverse).

test_cases.title: Evaluation of balise information validity in Shunting mode (Reverse direction)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Shunting (SH) mode. Train orientation is Nominal. A balise group is crossed in the Reverse direction.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise data containing: 1) Info valid for both directions, 2) Info valid for Reverse direction only, 3) Info valid for Nominal direction only.

steps.action: Cross the balise group in the Reverse direction while in SH mode.
steps.expected: The OBU takes into account the information valid for both directions.

steps.action: Check the status of the information valid for Reverse direction only.
steps.expected: The OBU takes into account the information valid for the crossing direction (Reverse).

steps.action: Check the status of the information valid for Nominal direction only.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the information valid only for the opposite direction (Nominal).

test_cases.title: MA request parameters persistence and immediate request on new parameter receipt
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 mode. Current MA request parameters: Repetition = Yes, Period = 10s. Time since last MA request is 12s (which is >= 10s).
test_cases.test_inputs: New MA request parameters from RBC: Repetition = Yes, Period = 5s.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU allows simulation of time passage or parameter update timing.

steps.action: Receive new MA request parameters from the RBC specifying a repetition period of 5s.
steps.expected: The OBU replaces the old parameters with the new ones immediately.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's behavior immediately after receiving the new parameters.
steps.expected: Since the time since the last MA request (12s) is higher than the newly received repetition period (5s), the OBU sends an MA request immediately.

test_cases.title: MA request parameters persistence when time since last request is less than new period
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 mode. Current MA request parameters: Repetition = Yes, Period = 10s. Time since last MA request is 2s.
test_cases.test_inputs: New MA request parameters from RBC: Repetition = Yes, Period = 5s.

steps.action: Receive new MA request parameters from the RBC specifying a repetition period of 5s.
steps.expected: The OBU replaces the old parameters with the new ones immediately.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's behavior immediately after receiving the new parameters.
steps.expected: Since the time since the last MA request (2s) is less than the newly received repetition period (5s), the OBU does NOT send an MA request immediately. It waits for the next repetition interval.

test_cases.title: No Supervised Location defined while supervising Limit of Authority
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 mode. The train is supervising a Limit of Authority (LoA) with a target speed above zero. The train is approaching a Danger Point which is a candidate for Supervised Location (SvL).
test_cases.test_inputs: Train movement towards the Danger Point within the LoA.
test_cases.assumptions: The LoA end is beyond the Danger Point.

steps.action: Move the train such that it passes the location of the Danger Point while still supervising the Limit of Authority.
steps.expected: The OBU does not define the Danger Point as a Supervised Location (SvL). The train speed is not constrained by SvL logic at this point, but by the LoA supervision.

test_cases.title: Level 1 speed restriction validity until new restriction received
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 1 mode. A signalling related speed restriction of 50 km/h is active.
test_cases.test_inputs: No new speed restriction received initially. Then, a new speed restriction of 80 km/h is received.

steps.action: Operate the train in Level 1 mode with the 50 km/h restriction active, without receiving any new restriction.
steps.expected: The OBU continues to apply the 50 km/h speed restriction.

steps.action: Receive a new signalling related speed restriction of 80 km/h.
steps.expected: The OBU replaces the 50 km/h restriction with the 80 km/h restriction immediately upon receipt.

test_cases.title: Level 1 speed restriction remains valid after switch to Level 2 until MA accepted
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 1 mode. A signalling related speed restriction of 50 km/h is active.
test_cases.test_inputs: Switch to Level 2 mode. No Level 2 MA accepted yet.

steps.action: Switch the OBU from Level 1 to Level 2 mode while the 50 km/h restriction is active.
steps.expected: The OBU remains in a state where the 50 km/h restriction is still considered valid.

steps.action: Operate the train in Level 2 mode before accepting a Level 2 MA.
steps.expected: The OBU continues to apply the 50 km/h speed restriction.

steps.action: Accept a Level 2 Movement Authority (MA).
steps.expected: The Level 1 signalling related speed restriction is no longer applied (replaced by Level 2 logic/MA).

test_cases.title: Maximum Train Speed defined as Static Speed Restriction
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is configured with a specific train performance profile.
test_cases.test_inputs: Configuration value for Maximum Train Speed (e.g., 200 km/h).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU allows configuration of Maximum Train Speed.

steps.action: Set the Maximum Train Speed to 200 km/h in the OBU configuration.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the value.

steps.action: Check the internal handling of this value.
steps.expected: The OBU handles the 200 km/h value as the Maximum Train Speed category of Static Speed Restriction.

test_cases.title: Initial state 'no speed restriction' for permitted braking distance
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on and in a state where no trackside data for speed restrictions has been received yet.
test_cases.test_inputs: None (initial state).

steps.action: Start the OBU and observe the speed restriction status before any trackside data is received.
steps.expected: The OBU uses 'no speed restriction' as the initial state. No permitted-braking-distance limit constrains the train speed based on speed restrictions.

test_cases.title: Resumption of 'no speed restriction' state on trackside order
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 mode. A speed restriction is currently active (e.g., 100 km/h).
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside order to resume initial state (no speed restriction).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can receive a specific trackside order to clear speed restrictions.

steps.action: Receive a trackside order to resume the initial state for speed restrictions.
steps.expected: The OBU clears the active speed restriction.

steps.action: Observe the speed limit applied to the train.
steps.expected: No permitted-braking-distance limit constrains the train speed due to speed restrictions.

test_cases.title: Safe radio connection loss triggers re-establishment attempt
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in an established communication session with a specific radio system (e.g., GSM-R). EURORADIO is active.
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulated loss of safe radio connection signal from EURORADIO.
test_cases.assumptions: The radio system used for the initial connection is available and functional for re-establishment.

steps.action: Establish a safe radio connection with Radio System A.
steps.expected: OBU reports successful connection with Radio System A.

steps.action: Simulate EURORADIO reporting the loss of the safe radio connection.
steps.expected: OBU immediately initiates an attempt to set up a new safe radio connection with Radio System A.

test_cases.title: Repeated re-establishment attempts until success
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in an established communication session. Safe radio connection is lost.
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulated radio environment where the first two re-establishment attempts fail, and the third succeeds.
test_cases.assumptions: The session is not terminated and the train has not passed the RIU termination location.

steps.action: Simulate loss of safe radio connection.
steps.expected: OBU starts repeating attempts to set up a new safe radio connection.

steps.action: Allow the first re-establishment attempt to fail.
steps.expected: OBU continues to repeat the attempt to set up a new safe radio connection.

steps.action: Allow the second re-establishment attempt to fail.
steps.expected: OBU continues to repeat the attempt to set up a new safe radio connection.

steps.action: Allow the third re-establishment attempt to succeed.
steps.expected: OBU establishes the safe radio connection and stops repeating the attempts.

test_cases.title: Re-establishment attempts stop when session is terminated
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in an established communication session. Safe radio connection is lost.
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulated radio environment where re-establishment attempts fail. Command to terminate communication session.
test_cases.assumptions: The train has not passed the RIU termination location.

steps.action: Simulate loss of safe radio connection.
steps.expected: OBU starts repeating attempts to set up a new safe radio connection.

steps.action: Allow the first re-establishment attempt to fail.
steps.expected: OBU continues to repeat the attempt.

steps.action: Issue a command to terminate the communication session.
steps.expected: OBU regards the session as terminated and stops repeating the attempts to set up a new safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: Re-establishment attempts stop when train passes RIU termination location
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in an established communication session. Safe radio connection is lost. An RIU order specifying a termination location is active.
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulated radio environment where re-establishment attempts fail. Train movement data indicating passage of the RIU termination location.
test_cases.assumptions: The session is not otherwise terminated.

steps.action: Simulate loss of safe radio connection.
steps.expected: OBU starts repeating attempts to set up a new safe radio connection.

steps.action: Allow the first re-establishment attempt to fail.
steps.expected: OBU continues to repeat the attempt.

steps.action: Simulate the train passing the location given in the RIU order to terminate the communication session.
steps.expected: OBU stops repeating the attempts to set up a new safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: OBU initiates termination upon trackside order
test_cases.preconditions: An active communication session is established between the OBU and the trackside (RBC).
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside sends a 'Termination of Communication Session' order.

steps.action: The trackside sends a termination order to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the termination of the communication session.

test_cases.title: OBU does not initiate termination without trackside order or condition
test_cases.preconditions: An active communication session is established. No termination conditions from SUBSET-026 are fulfilled.
test_cases.test_inputs: No trackside order is sent. No termination condition is triggered.

steps.action: Wait for a duration longer than the fixed waiting time without any trackside order or termination condition.
steps.expected: The OBU does not initiate the termination of the communication session.

test_cases.title: OBU repeats termination message if no acknowledgement is received
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has initiated the termination of the communication session and sent the 'Termination of Communication Session' message.
test_cases.test_inputs: No acknowledgement is received from the trackside within the fixed waiting time.
test_cases.assumptions: The fixed waiting time and repetition count are defined in SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.1.

steps.action: The OBU sends the 'Termination of Communication Session' message.
steps.expected: The OBU waits for the fixed waiting time.

steps.action: The fixed waiting time expires without an acknowledgement.
steps.expected: The OBU repeats the 'Termination of Communication Session' message.

test_cases.title: OBU considers session terminated after maximum repetitions without acknowledgement
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in the process of terminating the communication session and has been repeating the termination message.
test_cases.test_inputs: No acknowledgement is received after the last repetition.
test_cases.assumptions: The defined number of repetitions is reached as per SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.1.

steps.action: The OBU sends the 'Termination of Communication Session' message for the defined maximum number of times.
steps.expected: The OBU waits for the fixed waiting time after the last sending.

steps.action: The fixed waiting time expires without an acknowledgement.
steps.expected: The OBU considers the communication session terminated.

test_cases.title: Güç açıldığında GSM-R kayıt talebinin gönderilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU kapalı durumdadır. GSM-R Mobil Terminal bağlıdır ve çalışır durumdadır.
test_cases.assumptions: GSM-R ağının mevcut olduğu varsayılır.

steps.action: OBU güç açma komutuyla başlatılır.
steps.expected: OBU, bağlı GSM-R Mobil Terminal'in GSM-R Radyo Ağı'na kaydolması için bir kayıt talebi (registration request) gönderir.

test_cases.title: Sürücünün yeni GSM-R Radyo Ağı kimliği girmesi üzerine kayıt talebi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU çalışır durumdadır. GSM-R Mobil Terminal bağlıdır. Mevcut kayıt farklı bir ağ kimliği içindir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Yeni GSM-R Radyo Ağı kimliği (PLMN ID).

steps.action: Sürücü arayüzünden yeni bir GSM-R Radyo Ağı kimliği girilir ve onaylanır.
steps.expected: OBU, GSM-R Mobil Terminal'in yeni girilen kimliğe sahip GSM-R Radyo Ağı'na kaydolması için bir kayıt talebi gönderir.

test_cases.title: Yol kenarı komutu üzerine GSM-R kayıt talebi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU çalışır durumdadır. GSM-R Mobil Terminal bağlıdır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Yol kenarından gelen kayıt komutu (trackside order).

steps.action: Yol kenarı sisteminden OBU'ya GSM-R kayıt komutu gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, GSM-R Mobil Terminal'in GSM-R Radyo Ağı'na kaydolması için bir kayıt talebi gönderir.

test_cases.title: Hafızada Radyo Ağı tipi yokken varsayılan tipin kullanılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU'da hafızada Radyo Ağı tipi bulunmamaktadır (ilk güç açılışı veya sistem hatası sonrası). Araca yüklü varsayılan Radyo Ağı tipi yapılandırılmıştır.
test_cases.assumptions: Varsayılan Radyo Ağı tipi 'GSM-R' olarak yapılandırılmıştır.

steps.action: OBU güç açılır ve Radyo Ağı tipi sorgulanır.
steps.expected: OBU, hafızada tip olmadığı için araçta yapılandırılmış varsayılan Radyo Ağı tipini kullanır.

test_cases.title: Kayıtlı olmayan radyo sistemiyle RBC oturumu talebinin reddedilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU çalışır durumdadır. Depolanan Radyo Ağı tipi GSM-R'dir. GSM-R Mobil Terminal bağlıdır ancak GSM-R Radyo Ağı'na kayıtlı değildir (örneğin sinyal yok).
test_cases.test_inputs: Yol kenarından gelen RBC oturumu kurma komutu.

steps.action: Yol kenarı sisteminden RBC ile oturum kurma komutu gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, gerekli radyo sisteminin (GSM-R) ağa kayıtlı olmaması nedeniyle güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulumu talebinde bulunmaz.

test_cases.title: Kayıtlı olmayan GSM-R terminaliyle RIU oturumu talebinin reddedilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU çalışır durumdadır. GSM-R Mobil Terminal bağlıdır ancak GSM-R Radyo Ağı'na düzgünce kayıtlı değildir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Yol kenarından gelen RIU ile iletişim oturumu kurma komutu.

steps.action: Yol kenarı sisteminden RIU ile iletişim oturumu kurma komutu gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, GSM-R Mobil Terminal'in GSM-R Radyo Ağı'na kayıtlı olmaması nedeniyle güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulumu talebinde bulunmaz.

test_cases.title: Güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulduğunda 'Connection Up' göstergesinin kontrolü
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, RBC/RIU ile güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurma yeteneğine sahiptir. Sürücü arayüzü aktiftir.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC/RIU ile başarılı bir bağlantı kurulumu.

steps.action: OBU, ilgili RBC/RIU ile güvenli radyo bağlantısını başarıyla kurar.
steps.expected: Sürücüye 'Connection Up' durumu gösterilir.

test_cases.title: Bağlantı yokken 'No Connection' göstergesinin kontrolü
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, RBC/RIU ile aktif bir güvenli radyo bağlantısına sahip değildir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Bağlantı kurulmamış durum.

steps.action: OBU, RBC/RIU ile bağlantı kurma girişiminde bulunmadan veya bağlantı kuramadan bekletilir.
steps.expected: Sürücüye 'No Connection' durumu gösterilir.

test_cases.title: Bağlantı kaybında 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' göstergesinin kontrolü
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, RBC/RIU ile aktif bir güvenli radyo bağlantısına sahiptir.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC/RIU ile bağlantının kesilmesi veya kurulumun başarısız olması.

steps.action: Aktif olan güvenli radyo bağlantısı kesilir veya yeni bir bağlantı kurulumu başarısız olur.
steps.expected: Sürücüye 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' durumu gösterilir.

test_cases.title: Oturum kurulumu için ilk istek gönderildiğinde zamanlayıcının başlatılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, RBC/RIU ile oturum kurma sürecindedir (SUBSET-026 §3.5.3.4 b) to e)).
test_cases.test_inputs: Oturum kurulumu için ilk istek mesajı.
test_cases.assumptions: Bağlantı durumu zamanlayıcısının durumu izlenebilir veya loglanabilir.

steps.action: OBU, ilgili RBC/RIU ile oturum kurmak için ilk istek mesajını gönderir.
steps.expected: Bağlantı durumu zamanlayıcısı başlatılır.

test_cases.title: Oturum sürdürme için ilk istek gönderildiğinde zamanlayıcının başlatılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, RBC/RIU ile oturum sürdürme sürecindedir (SUBSET-026 §3.5.4.2, §3.5.4.4).
test_cases.test_inputs: Oturum sürdürme için ilk istek mesajı.
test_cases.assumptions: Bağlantı durumu zamanlayıcısının durumu izlenebilir veya loglanabilir.

steps.action: OBU, ilgili RBC/RIU ile oturumu sürdürmek için ilk istek mesajını gönderir.
steps.expected: Bağlantı durumu zamanlayıcısı başlatılır.

test_cases.title: Geçerli durum geçişlerinin kontrolü (No Connection -> Connection Up)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, 'No Connection' durumundadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Bağlantı kurulumu için gerekli koşulların sağlanması.
test_cases.assumptions: SUBSET-026 Tablo 1 ve Tablo 2'de tanımlı geçiş koşulları bilinmektedir.

steps.action: SUBSET-026 Tablo 2'de 'No Connection' durumundan 'Connection Up' durumuna geçiş için gerekli koşullar sağlanır.
steps.expected: OBU, durumu 'Connection Up' olarak değiştirir. Geçiş, Tablo 1'de tanımlı geçerli geçişlerden biridir.

test_cases.title: Geçersiz durum geçişinin engellenmesi (No Connection -> Connection Lost/Set-Up failed)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, 'No Connection' durumundadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Geçersiz geçiş koşullarının simüle edilmesi.
test_cases.assumptions: SUBSET-026 Tablo 1'de 'No Connection' durumundan doğrudan 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' durumuna geçişin tanımlı olmadığı varsayılır (genellikle 'Connection Up' veya 'Set-Up' ara durumları üzerinden geçilir).

steps.action: OBU, 'No Connection' durumundayken, SUBSET-026 Tablo 1'de tanımlı olmayan bir geçiş koşulu ile 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' durumuna geçmeye çalışır.
steps.expected: OBU, durumu 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' olarak değiştirmez. Geçerli bir geçiş yolu izlenir veya durum değişmez.

test_cases.title: Birden fazla RIU bağlantısında mevcut infill alanına ait durumun gösterilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, birden fazla Radio Infill Unit (RIU) ile güvenli radyo bağlantısına sahiptir. Araç, belirli bir infill alanındadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Mevcut infill alanına ait RIU'nun bağlantı durumu.
test_cases.assumptions: OBU'nun hangi RIU'nun 'mevcut infill alanına' ait olduğunu belirleyebildiği varsayılır.

steps.action: OBU, mevcut infill alanına ait RIU ile 'Connection Up' durumundadır, ancak başka bir RIU ile 'Connection Lost' durumundadır.
steps.expected: Sürücüye, mevcut infill alanına ait RIU'nun durumu olan 'Connection Up' gösterilir.

test_cases.title: ETC-023: Geçersiz konumdan geçerli konuma geçiş (LRBG)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, tren konumunun geçersiz olduğunu raporluyor. Geçersiz bir konum değeri bellekte saklı.
test_cases.test_inputs: LRBG geçiş sinyali.
test_cases.assumptions: LRBG geçişi, geçerli bir konum verisi sağlar.

steps.action: Tren, LRBG üzerinden geçer.
steps.expected: OBU, LRBG'den gelen geçerli tren konumunu kabul eder ve saklar.

steps.action: OBU'nun iç konum durumu sorgulanır.
steps.expected: Önceki geçersiz konum silinmiş, yeni geçerli konum aktif olarak kullanılmaktadır.

test_cases.title: ETC-023: Geçersiz konumdan geçerli konuma geçiş (ORBG)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, tren konumunun geçersiz olduğunu raporluyor. Geçersiz bir konum değeri bellekte saklı.
test_cases.test_inputs: ORBG geçiş sinyali.
test_cases.assumptions: ORBG geçişi, geçerli bir konum verisi sağlar.

steps.action: Tren, ORBG üzerinden geçer.
steps.expected: OBU, ORBG'den gelen geçerli tren konumunu kabul eder ve saklar.

steps.action: OBU'nun iç konum durumu sorgulanır.
steps.expected: Önceki geçersiz konum silinmiş, yeni geçerli konum aktif olarak kullanılmaktadır.

test_cases.title: ETC-024: Aktif kabin varken yön tanımlaması
test_cases.preconditions: Trenin iki kabini vardır. Kabin A aktif, Kabin B pasif.
test_cases.test_inputs: Kabin A aktif durumu.
test_cases.assumptions: Kabin A, trenin ön tarafını temsil eder.

steps.action: OBU'nun tren yönü (orientation) parametresi sorgulanır.
steps.expected: OBU, aktif kabinin (Kabin A) tarafını trenin önü olarak tanımlar.

test_cases.title: ETC-024: Aktif kabin yokken son aktif kabine göre yön tanımlaması
test_cases.preconditions: Trenin iki kabini vardır. Kabin A son olarak aktif olan kabindi, ardından pasife alındı. Kabin B hiç aktif olmadı veya daha önce pasifti. Şu an hiçbir kabin aktif değil.
test_cases.test_inputs: Tüm kabinler pasif.
test_cases.assumptions: Sistem, son aktif kabin bilgisini tutmaktadır.

steps.action: OBU'nun tren yönü (orientation) parametresi sorgulanır.
steps.expected: OBU, son aktif kabinin (Kabin A) tarafını trenin önü olarak tanımlar.

test_cases.title: ETC-025: Konum tabanlı denetimde ön uç konumunun referans olarak kullanılması
test_cases.preconditions: Tren hareket halinde. OBU, konum tabanlı bir bilgiyi (örneğin sinyal mesafesi) denetlemektedir. SUBSET-026'da bu fonksiyon için özel bir referans (maks güvenli ön uç vb.) belirtilmemiştir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trenin tahmini ön uç konumu (Estimated Front End Position).
test_cases.assumptions: Tahmini ön uç konumu, OBU tarafından hesaplanmaktadır.

steps.action: OBU'nun konum denetimi için kullandığı referans nokta sorgulanır.
steps.expected: OBU, trenin tahmini ön uç konumunu (estimated front end position) referans olarak kullanır.

test_cases.title: ETC-025: Özel referans gerektiren fonksiyonda (End Section Timer) maks güvenli ön ucun kullanılması
test_cases.preconditions: Tren, End Section sınırına yaklaşıyor. OBU, End Section timer'ını başlatmak için konum denetimi yapıyor.
test_cases.test_inputs: Maks güvenli ön uç konumu (Max Safe Front End).
test_cases.assumptions: SUBSET-026 §3.6.1.6, End Section timer için maks güvenli ön ucu referans olarak belirtir.

steps.action: OBU'nun End Section timer başlangıç konumu denetimi için kullandığı referans nokta sorgulanır.
steps.expected: OBU, tahmini ön uç konumu yerine, SUBSET-026'da belirtildiği gibi maks güvenli ön uç konumunu (max safe front end) referans olarak kullanır.

test_cases.title: ETC-025: Özel referans gerektiren fonksiyonda (Level Transition) min güvenli arka ucun kullanılması
test_cases.preconditions: Tren, seviye geçiş sınırına (level transition border) yaklaşıyor. OBU, bu sınırı geçiş denetimi yapıyor.
test_cases.test_inputs: Min güvenli arka uç konumu (Min Safe Rear End).
test_cases.assumptions: SUBSET-026 §3.6.1.6, seviye geçiş sınırı için min güvenli arka ucu referans olarak belirtir.

steps.action: OBU'nun seviye geçiş sınırı denetimi için kullandığı referans nokta sorgulanır.
steps.expected: OBU, tahmini ön uç konumu yerine, SUBSET-026'da belirtildiği gibi min güvenli arka uç konumunu (min safe rear end) referans olarak kullanır.

test_cases.title: Report position to RBC referring to last passed compliant LRBG
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. A compliant LRBG (e.g., LRBG-100) has been passed. The OBU has reported its position to the RBC.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train moves forward past LRBG-100. RBC sends a trackside message referencing LRBG-100.
test_cases.assumptions: The LRBG-100 is marked as linked and announced in linking, satisfying the compliance condition. The minimum number of recently reported LRBGs is set to 1.

steps.action: Move the train past the compliant LRBG-100.
steps.expected: The OBU reports the train position to the RBC, referencing LRBG-100.

steps.action: Receive a trackside information message from the RBC that references LRBG-100.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the trackside information.

test_cases.title: Accept trackside info referencing a recently reported LRBG within minimum count
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. The minimum number of recently reported LRBGs is set to 2. LRBG-100 and LRBG-200 have been passed and reported to the RBC in that order.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC sends a trackside message referencing LRBG-100 (the older of the two recent LRBGs).
test_cases.assumptions: Both LRBG-100 and LRBG-200 are compliant. The current position is after LRBG-200.

steps.action: Pass LRBG-100 and LRBG-200 sequentially, ensuring both are reported to the RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU maintains a history of the last 2 reported LRBGs.

steps.action: Receive a trackside information message from the RBC referencing LRBG-100.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the trackside information, as LRBG-100 is within the minimum number of recently reported LRBGs.

test_cases.title: Reject trackside info referencing an LRBG outside the minimum recent count
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. The minimum number of recently reported LRBGs is set to 1. LRBG-100 and LRBG-200 have been passed and reported in that order.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC sends a trackside message referencing LRBG-100.
test_cases.assumptions: LRBG-200 is the most recently reported LRBG. LRBG-100 is no longer within the 'recently reported' window defined by the minimum count of 1.

steps.action: Pass LRBG-100 and then LRBG-200, ensuring both are reported.
steps.expected: The OBU updates its recent LRBG history to contain only LRBG-200 (based on min count 1).

steps.action: Receive a trackside information message from the RBC referencing LRBG-100.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects or ignores the trackside information, as LRBG-100 is not within the minimum number of recently reported LRBGs.

test_cases.title: Report position using unlinked LRBG when linking consistency is not checked
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. Linking consistency check is disabled or the LRBG is not marked as unlinked. A balise group (LRBG-300) is present but not linked/announced in linking.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train passes LRBG-300.
test_cases.assumptions: Since linking consistency is not checked (or the LRBG is not marked as unlinked), LRBG-300 is considered compliant for position reporting.

steps.action: Move the train past LRBG-300.
steps.expected: The OBU reports the train position to the RBC, referencing LRBG-300.

test_cases.title: OBU ignores information invalid for train orientation
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. Train orientation is set to 'Forward'.
test_cases.test_inputs: A transmission medium message containing data valid only for 'Reverse' orientation.
test_cases.assumptions: The test environment allows injection of specific orientation-valid data.

steps.action: Inject a message from a transmission medium containing data valid only for the 'Reverse' orientation while the train orientation is 'Forward'.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the received information and does not update its internal state with the invalid data.

steps.action: Inject a message from a transmission medium containing data valid for the 'Forward' orientation.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts and processes the information.

test_cases.title: OBU rejects one-direction data when orientation is unknown
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. The train orientation cannot be related to the direction of the trackside device (e.g., unknown balise group crossing direction for SL/PS/SH engines).
test_cases.test_inputs: 1. Data valid in one direction only. 2. Data valid in both directions.
test_cases.assumptions: The system state is configured such that orientation relation is impossible/unknown.

steps.action: Inject data valid in one direction only from a transmission medium.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the data.

steps.action: Inject data valid in both directions from a transmission medium.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates and accepts the data.

test_cases.title: Interpretation of continuous profile data with incremental distances
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is ready to receive continuous profile data. Previous data state is known (e.g., Value A).
test_cases.test_inputs: Sequence of values: [Value B, Value C, Value D] with distances [10, 20, 0].
test_cases.assumptions: SUBSET-026 §3.6.3.2.2 and Figure 12 definitions are implemented as described.

steps.action: Send continuous profile data where the first value is Value B and the first distance is 10.
steps.expected: The OBU applies the previously received data (Value A) over the first 10 distance units.

steps.action: Continue the profile with Value C and distance 20.
steps.expected: The OBU applies Value B over the next 20 distance units (from 10 to 30).

steps.action: Continue the profile with Value D and distance 0.
steps.expected: The OBU applies Value C over the next 0 distance units (effectively no length, but transition occurs). Value D becomes the current value.

steps.action: Check the profile state beyond the last defined distance.
steps.expected: The OBU applies Value D without limit, as it is the last value and not an end-of-profile value.

test_cases.title: Interpretation of continuous profile data with zero distance value
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is ready to receive continuous profile data.
test_cases.test_inputs: Sequence of values: [Value X] with distance 0.

steps.action: Send a continuous profile value Value X followed by a zero distance.
steps.expected: The OBU takes Value X into account as the current value, even though the distance is zero.

test_cases.title: Interpretation of location data with unsigned increments
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is ready to receive location data. Previous location data state is known (e.g., Location Data A).
test_cases.test_inputs: Location data sequence: [Location Data B, Location Data C] with distances [5, 15].
test_cases.assumptions: SUBSET-026 Figure 12 definitions are implemented as described.

steps.action: Send location data where the first value is Location Data B and the first distance is 5.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the previously received data (Location Data A) over the first 5 distance units.

steps.action: Continue with Location Data C and distance 15.
steps.expected: The OBU applies Location Data B over the next 15 distance units (from 5 to 20).

steps.action: Check the location data state beyond the last defined distance.
steps.expected: The OBU applies Location Data C for the remaining distance.

test_cases.title: Interpretation of non-continuous profile data with overlapping elements
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is ready to receive non-continuous profile data. Initial/default data is known (e.g., Default Data).
test_cases.test_inputs: Elements: 1. (Value A, Length 10, Start Dist 5), 2. (Value B, Length 10, Start Dist 5).
test_cases.assumptions: SUBSET-026 §3.6.3.2.4 and Figure 12 definitions are implemented as described.

steps.action: Send the first element: Value A, Length 10, Start Distance 5 from previous (initial).
steps.expected: The OBU uses Default Data for the first 5 distance units. Value A is applied from distance 5 to 15.

steps.action: Send the second element: Value B, Length 10, Start Distance 5 from the start of the previous element (distance 5).
steps.expected: The start of Value B is at distance 5 + 5 = 10. Value B is applied from distance 10 to 20. The OBU accepts the overlap between Value A (5-15) and Value B (10-20).

steps.action: Query the profile value at distance 12.
steps.expected: The OBU returns Value B, as it is the most recently defined element covering that distance (or according to specific overlap resolution rules defined in SUBSET-026, typically last received wins or specific priority, but the requirement states 'accept that elements overlap', implying no error is raised).

test_cases.title: Interpretation of linking information for balise groups
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is ready to receive linking information.
test_cases.test_inputs: Linking data: 1. (Link Data A, Dist 100), 2. (Link Data B, Dist 50).
test_cases.assumptions: SUBSET-026 §3.6.3.2.6 and Figure 12 definitions are implemented as described.

steps.action: Send linking information with the first value Link Data A and distance 100.
steps.expected: The OBU interprets this as Link Data A for the first announced balise group, located at distance 100 from the current reference point.

steps.action: Send the next value Link Data B and distance 50.
steps.expected: The OBU interprets this as Link Data B for the second announced balise group, located at distance 100 + 50 = 150 from the current reference point.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy from linking information
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. A balise group (BG-A) is detected. Linking information containing location accuracy for BG-A is available.
test_cases.test_inputs: Linking information with specific location accuracy value for BG-A.
test_cases.assumptions: The location accuracy value in linking information is valid and distinct from National/Default values.

steps.action: Detect balise group BG-A and process the associated linking information.
steps.expected: The OBU assigns the location accuracy from the linking information to BG-A.

steps.action: Check the internal state of the location accuracy for BG-A.
steps.expected: The stored location accuracy matches the value provided in the linking information.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy fallback to National Value
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. A balise group (BG-B) is detected. No linking information determines the location accuracy for BG-B before it becomes LRBG/ORBG. A National Value for location accuracy is configured.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise group BG-B without linking accuracy data. National Value configured.
test_cases.assumptions: The National Value is distinct from the Default Value.

steps.action: Detect balise group BG-B and allow it to become LRBG/ORBG without prior linking accuracy determination.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the configured National Value for the location accuracy of BG-B.

steps.action: Check the internal state of the location accuracy for BG-B.
steps.expected: The stored location accuracy matches the National Value.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy fallback to Default Value
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. A balise group (BG-C) is detected. No linking information determines the location accuracy for BG-C before it becomes LRBG/ORBG. No National Value applies.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise group BG-C without linking accuracy data. No National Value configured.
test_cases.assumptions: The Default Value is defined in the system configuration.

steps.action: Detect balise group BG-C and allow it to become LRBG/ORBG without prior linking accuracy determination.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the Default Value for the location accuracy of BG-C.

steps.action: Check the internal state of the location accuracy for BG-C.
steps.expected: The stored location accuracy matches the Default Value.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy remains fixed after determination
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has determined the location accuracy for a balise group (BG-D) using linking information.
test_cases.test_inputs: New linking information with a different location accuracy for BG-D.
test_cases.assumptions: The new linking information is valid but contains a different accuracy value.

steps.action: Receive new linking information for BG-D with a different location accuracy value.
steps.expected: The OBU does not update the location accuracy of BG-D.

steps.action: Check the internal state of the location accuracy for BG-D.
steps.expected: The stored location accuracy remains the original value determined previously.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy remains fixed when linking is no longer checked
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has determined the location accuracy for a balise group (BG-E). Linking consistency checking is active.
test_cases.test_inputs: Change in system state to stop checking linking consistency.
test_cases.assumptions: The system can transition to a state where linking consistency is not checked.

steps.action: Transition the system to a state where linking consistency is no longer checked.
steps.expected: The OBU does not update the location accuracy of BG-E.

steps.action: Check the internal state of the location accuracy for BG-E.
steps.expected: The stored location accuracy remains the original value.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy remains fixed when new National Values apply
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has determined the location accuracy for a balise group (BG-F). A new National Value for location accuracy becomes applicable.
test_cases.test_inputs: Update configuration to apply a new National Value.
test_cases.assumptions: The new National Value is different from the currently applied one.

steps.action: Apply a new National Value for location accuracy.
steps.expected: The OBU does not update the location accuracy of BG-F.

steps.action: Check the internal state of the location accuracy for BG-F.
steps.expected: The stored location accuracy remains the original value.

test_cases.title: Confidence interval calculation without consist length uncertainty
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a situation where consist length uncertainty is not applicable (per SUBSET-026 §3.6.4.1.5). Location accuracy (LA) and over/under-reading amount (OU) are known.
test_cases.test_inputs: Estimated front end position, LA, OU.
test_cases.assumptions: Consist length uncertainty is zero or not included in the calculation for this scenario.

steps.action: Calculate the min safe front end position.
steps.expected: Min safe front end = Estimated front end - (LA + OU).

steps.action: Calculate the max safe front end position.
steps.expected: Max safe front end = Estimated front end + (LA + OU).

test_cases.title: Confidence interval calculation with consist length uncertainty
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a consist-length-related situation defined in SUBSET-026 §3.6.4.1.5. Location accuracy (LA), over/under-reading amount (OU), and consist length uncertainty (CLU) are known.
test_cases.test_inputs: Estimated front end position, LA, OU, CLU.
test_cases.assumptions: The specific situation triggers the inclusion of CLU.

steps.action: Calculate the min safe front end position.
steps.expected: Min safe front end = Estimated front end - (LA + OU + CLU).

steps.action: Calculate the max safe front end position.
steps.expected: Max safe front end = Estimated front end + (LA + OU + CLU).

test_cases.title: SOLR selection while linking consistency is checked
test_cases.preconditions: Linking consistency is being checked. Multiple balise groups have been received.
test_cases.test_inputs: Sequence of balise groups, some referenced in linking information, some not.
test_cases.assumptions: The most recently received balise group that is part of linking information is BG-X.

steps.action: Receive a sequence of balise groups where BG-X is the most recent one referenced in linking information.
steps.expected: The OBU selects BG-X as the Single On-board Location Reference (SOLR).

steps.action: Check the current SOLR.
steps.expected: The SOLR is BG-X.

test_cases.title: SOLR selection while linking consistency is not checked
test_cases.preconditions: Linking consistency is not being checked. Multiple balise groups have been received.
test_cases.test_inputs: Sequence of balise groups.
test_cases.assumptions: The last received balise group is BG-Y.

steps.action: Receive a sequence of balise groups ending with BG-Y.
steps.expected: The OBU selects BG-Y as the Single On-board Location Reference (SOLR).

steps.action: Check the current SOLR.
steps.expected: The SOLR is BG-Y.

test_cases.title: Applying linking replacement rule before updating SOLR
test_cases.preconditions: OBU receives linking information that triggers a change in SOLR.
test_cases.test_inputs: Linking information requiring SOLR update.
test_cases.assumptions: The linking replacement rule (SUBSET-026 §3.7.3.1 m)) is defined and applicable.

steps.action: Receive linking information that implies a new SOLR.
steps.expected: The OBU applies the linking replacement rule before updating the SOLR.

steps.action: Verify the order of operations in the OBU's internal log or state.
steps.expected: The replacement rule is applied prior to the SOLR update.

test_cases.title: Relocating non-linking information to SOLR before replacement
test_cases.preconditions: OBU receives location-based information (not linking information) that requires relocation.
test_cases.test_inputs: Location-based information referred to a balise group other than the current SOLR.
test_cases.assumptions: The corresponding replacement rule of §3.7.3.1 is defined.

steps.action: Receive location-based information referred to a non-SOLR balise group.
steps.expected: The OBU relocates the information to the SOLR.

steps.action: Verify the order of operations.
steps.expected: The relocation to SOLR occurs before applying the corresponding replacement rule.

test_cases.title: Processing location based information into three items
test_cases.preconditions: OBU receives location based information.
test_cases.test_inputs: Location based information with min, estimated, and max values.
test_cases.assumptions: The information type is associated with a clause in SUBSET-026 Table 2a.

steps.action: Process the received location based information.
steps.expected: The OBU creates three location items: 'min', 'estimated', and 'max'.

steps.action: Check the internal representation of the location items.
steps.expected: Three distinct items exist with the correct values.

test_cases.title: Applying clause using corresponding location item
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has processed location based information into min, estimated, and max items. SUBSET-026 Table 2a associates a specific clause with the 'min' location item for this information type.
test_cases.test_inputs: Location based information where the 'min' item is relevant for a specific clause.
test_cases.assumptions: The clause logic depends on the 'min' value.

steps.action: Evaluate the clause associated with the 'min' location item.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the 'min' location item value for the clause evaluation.

steps.action: Verify the result of the clause evaluation.
steps.expected: The result is consistent with using the 'min' value.

test_cases.title: Relocating location items to new SOLR
test_cases.preconditions: A new balise group becomes the SOLR. There are existing location items referred to the old SOLR.
test_cases.test_inputs: New SOLR, old SOLR, distance between them from linking information.
test_cases.assumptions: The distance between the old and new SOLR is known from linking information.

steps.action: Change the SOLR to a new balise group.
steps.expected: The OBU relocates all existing location items to the new SOLR.

steps.action: Check the distance values of the relocated location items.
steps.expected: The distance of each item is adjusted by subtracting the distance between the old and new SOLR.

test_cases.title: Relocating location items using travelled distance
test_cases.preconditions: Location based information referred to a balise group other than the SOLR is evaluated. The distance between the reference balise group and the SOLR is determined by travelled distance.
test_cases.test_inputs: Reference balise group, SOLR, travelled distance between them.
test_cases.assumptions: Linking information does not provide the distance, so travelled distance is used.

steps.action: Evaluate location based information referred to a non-SOLR balise group.
steps.expected: The OBU relocates the location items to the SOLR.

steps.action: Check the distance values of the relocated location items.
steps.expected: The distance of each item is adjusted by subtracting the travelled distance between the reference balise group and the SOLR.

test_cases.title: Driver requests display of estimated front end position
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a state where the driver can interact with the HMI. The train is moving or stationary with a valid position estimate.
test_cases.test_inputs: Driver command to display position.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU has a valid geographical reference location and distance travelled data available.

steps.action: Verify that the geographical position of the train's estimated front end is not displayed on the HMI.
steps.expected: The position display is hidden or inactive.

steps.action: The driver issues a request to display the geographical position.
steps.expected: The OBU displays the geographical position of the train's estimated front end in relation to the track kilometre.

test_cases.preconditions: The geographical position of the train's estimated front end is currently displayed on the HMI.

steps.expected: The position display is active and showing the track kilometre value.

steps.action: The driver issues a request to stop the display.
steps.expected: The OBU stops displaying the geographical position of the train's estimated front end.

test_cases.title: Position calculation includes distance travelled since reference
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has a known geographical reference location (e.g., Track Kilometre 10.000). The train has moved a known distance from this reference.
test_cases.test_inputs: Reference location: TK 10.000. Distance travelled: 500 meters.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU's internal odometry or distance calculation is accurate for the test segment.

steps.action: Set the geographical reference location to Track Kilometre 10.000.
steps.expected: The OBU records the reference location.

steps.action: Move the train 500 meters forward from the reference location.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the distance travelled as 500 meters.

steps.action: Request the display of the geographical position.
steps.expected: The OBU displays the position as Track Kilometre 10.500 (10.000 + 0.500).

test_cases.title: Position calculation with zero distance travelled
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has a known geographical reference location. The train is stationary at the reference location.
test_cases.test_inputs: Reference location: TK 20.000. Distance travelled: 0 meters.

steps.action: Set the geographical reference location to Track Kilometre 20.000.
steps.expected: The OBU records the reference location.

steps.action: Ensure the train remains stationary (distance travelled is 0).
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the distance travelled as 0 meters.

steps.action: Request the display of the geographical position.
steps.expected: The OBU displays the position as Track Kilometre 20.000.

test_cases.title: Supervision start calculates remaining distances for all SUBSET-026 §3.6.7.1 items
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a state where supervision can be started (e.g., after power-up or mode change). Valid SUBSET-026 data containing distances for roll-away, reverse movement, standstill, Post Trip reversing, trip suppression after Override, and Staff Responsible is available.
test_cases.test_inputs: SUBSET-026 data with defined distances for all items in §3.6.7.1.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU interface allows observation of the calculated remaining distance values for each specific distance type.

steps.action: Start the supervision function in the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the remaining distance to be travelled for the roll-away distance.

steps.action: Check the calculated remaining distance for the reverse movement distance.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the remaining distance to be travelled for the reverse movement distance.

steps.action: Check the calculated remaining distance for the standstill distance.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the remaining distance to be travelled for the standstill distance.

steps.action: Check the calculated remaining distance for the Post Trip reversing distance.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the remaining distance to be travelled for the Post Trip reversing distance.

steps.action: Check the calculated remaining distance for the trip suppression distance after Override.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the remaining distance to be travelled for the trip suppression distance after Override.

steps.action: Check the calculated remaining distance for the Staff Responsible maximum distance.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the remaining distance to be travelled for the Staff Responsible maximum distance.

test_cases.title: Supervision restart calculates remaining distances independently of balise position
test_cases.preconditions: OBU supervision is active. The train is positioned such that it is not immediately adjacent to a balise group (e.g., in the middle of a track section).
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid SUBSET-026 data. A trigger to restart supervision (e.g., loss and recovery of valid position or specific mode transition).
test_cases.assumptions: The train position is known to be away from balise groups to verify independence.

steps.action: Trigger a restart of the supervision function while the train is away from balise groups.
steps.expected: The OBU recalculates the remaining distance for the roll-away distance.

steps.action: Check the recalculated remaining distance for the standstill distance.
steps.expected: The OBU recalculates the remaining distance for the standstill distance.

steps.action: Check the recalculated remaining distance for the Staff Responsible maximum distance.
steps.expected: The OBU recalculates the remaining distance for the Staff Responsible maximum distance.

test_cases.title: Supervision of roll-away distance uses estimated distance travelled from start location
test_cases.preconditions: Supervision for roll-away distance is active. The train is at the location where supervision was started.
test_cases.test_inputs: Odometer data indicating movement away from the start location in the concerned direction.
test_cases.assumptions: The 'concerned direction' for roll-away is defined by the specific protection logic (typically forward or reverse depending on context, here assumed to be the direction of movement being supervised). The estimated distance travelled is observable or can be inferred from the remaining distance calculation.

steps.action: Move the train a known distance D1 away from the supervision start location in the concerned direction.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the remaining distance for roll-away protection by subtracting the estimated distance travelled (D1) from the initial roll-away distance.

steps.action: Move the train an additional distance D2 away from the start location.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the remaining distance for roll-away protection by subtracting the total estimated distance travelled (D1 + D2) from the initial roll-away distance.

test_cases.title: Supervision of standstill protection uses estimated distance travelled from start location
test_cases.preconditions: Supervision for standstill protection is active. The train is at the location where supervision was started.
test_cases.test_inputs: Odometer data indicating movement away from the start location.
test_cases.assumptions: Standstill protection supervision is triggered in a scenario where movement away from a specific point is monitored.

steps.action: Move the train a known distance D1 away from the supervision start location.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the remaining standstill protection distance as the initial standstill distance minus the estimated distance travelled (D1).

test_cases.title: Supervision of Post Trip reversing uses estimated distance travelled from start location
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Post Trip state. Supervision for reversing in Post Trip is active. The train is at the location where this supervision was started.
test_cases.test_inputs: Odometer data indicating reverse movement away from the start location.
test_cases.assumptions: The 'concerned direction' is reverse movement.

steps.action: Move the train in reverse a known distance D1 away from the supervision start location.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the remaining Post Trip reversing distance as the initial Post Trip reversing distance minus the estimated distance travelled in reverse (D1).

test_cases.title: Supervision of trip suppression after Override uses estimated distance travelled from start location
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a state where trip suppression after Override is active. Supervision was started at a specific location.
test_cases.test_inputs: Odometer data indicating movement away from the start location.
test_cases.assumptions: The trip suppression distance is defined in SUBSET-026.

steps.action: Move the train a known distance D1 away from the supervision start location.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the remaining trip suppression distance as the initial trip suppression distance minus the estimated distance travelled (D1).

test_cases.title: Supervision of zero distance to former EOA/LOA after Override without valid position
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has performed an Override. The position is invalid (no valid position). The former EOA/LOA is known. Supervision for the zero distance to this former EOA/LOA is active.
test_cases.test_inputs: Odometer data indicating movement. Estimated, max safe, and min safe front end values are available.
test_cases.assumptions: The 'virtual train front position' is derived from the estimated, max safe, and min safe front ends. The correction for odometer under/over-reading is applied as per §3.6.7.3.

steps.action: Move the train a known distance D1.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the remaining distance to the former EOA/LOA by subtracting the distance travelled (corrected by odometer error) from the supervised distance (which is zero relative to the former EOA/LOA start point, effectively monitoring the virtual front position against the limit).

test_cases.title: Supervision of Staff Responsible distance uses virtual train front position
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Staff Responsible mode. Supervision for the Staff Responsible maximum distance is active. The start location for this supervision is known.
test_cases.test_inputs: Odometer data indicating movement. Estimated, max safe, and min safe front end values are available.
test_cases.assumptions: The Staff Responsible distance is defined in SUBSET-026 §3.6.7.1 f), g). The virtual train front position is derived from the estimated, max safe, and min safe front ends.

steps.action: Move the train a known distance D1.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the remaining Staff Responsible distance as the supervised distance minus the distance travelled, where the distance travelled is corrected by odometer under/over-reading, and the reference is the virtual train front position.

test_cases.title: Replacement of track description from start location

steps.expected: The OBU triggers and sends an MA request to the RBC.

steps.expected: The OBU triggers and sends an MA request to the RBC.

test_cases.title: End Section timer start upon passing start location
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode. A Movement Authority (MA) containing an End Section timer start location and a non-zero timeout value is received from trackside. The train's max safe front end is located before the End Section timer start location.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA with End Section timer start location at 1000m, timeout 30s. Train speed 50 km/h.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU provides a diagnostic interface to observe the state of the End Section timer (running/stopped) and its start time.

steps.action: Move the train such that the max safe front end passes the End Section timer start location (1000m).
steps.expected: The OBU starts the End Section timer. The timer state changes to 'running' and the start timestamp corresponds to the moment the max safe front end passed the location.

test_cases.title: End Section timer timeout consequences
test_cases.preconditions: The End Section timer is running. The MA contains location-based information (e.g., speed limits) and a non-zero target speed at the End of Movement Authority (EOA).
test_cases.test_inputs: End Section timer timeout value set to 5 seconds for test purposes. Train is moving within the End Section.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU allows observation of the EOA/LOA position, target speed at EOA, and the list of active location-based information.

steps.action: Wait for the End Section timer to exceed the timeout value.
steps.expected: The OBU withdraws the EOA/LOA to the train's current position. The location-based information listed in SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.4 is deleted. The target speed at the new EOA is set to zero.

test_cases.title: LOA speed timer start in Level 2
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is operating in Level 2. A Movement Authority (MA) message containing a LOA speed timer timeout value is received.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA message with timestamp T0. LOA speed timer timeout 10s.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU provides a diagnostic interface to observe the LOA speed timer start timestamp.

steps.action: Receive the MA message at time T0.
steps.expected: The OBU starts the LOA speed timer. The timer start timestamp is equal to T0 (the timestamp of the message containing the MA).

test_cases.title: LOA speed timer start in Level 1
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is operating in Level 1. The train is approaching a balise group that provides the Movement Authority (MA).
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise group with MA. Train speed 30 km/h.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU provides a diagnostic interface to observe the LOA speed timer start timestamp and the train's position relative to the balise.

steps.action: Move the train to pass the first encountered balise of the balise group giving the MA.
steps.expected: The OBU starts the LOA speed timer. The timer start timestamp corresponds to the moment the train passed the first balise of the group.

test_cases.title: LOA speed timer timeout consequences
test_cases.preconditions: The LOA speed timer is running. The current LOA has a non-zero speed associated with it. Location-based information is present.
test_cases.test_inputs: LOA speed timer timeout value set to 5 seconds for test purposes.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU allows observation of the LOA speed, EOA status, and location-based information.

steps.action: Wait for the LOA speed timer to exceed the timeout value.
steps.expected: The OBU sets the speed associated with the LOA to zero. The LOA becomes an EOA with the Supervised Location (SvL) defined per SUBSET-026 §3.8.4.5. The location-based information listed in SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.4 is deleted.

test_cases.title: Overlap timer start upon passing start location
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode. A Movement Authority (MA) containing an Overlap timer start location and a non-zero timeout value is received. The train's max safe front end is before the start location.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA with Overlap timer start location at 2000m, timeout 20s.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU provides a diagnostic interface to observe the Overlap timer state.

steps.action: Move the train such that the max safe front end passes the Overlap timer start location (2000m).
steps.expected: The OBU starts the Overlap timer. The timer state changes to 'running'.

test_cases.title: Overlap timer start with infinite timeout
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode. A Movement Authority (MA) containing an Overlap timer start location and a timeout value of 'infinite' is received. The train's max safe front end is before the start location.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA with Overlap timer start location at 2000m, timeout 'infinite'.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU provides a diagnostic interface to observe the Overlap timer state.

steps.action: Move the train such that the max safe front end passes the Overlap timer start location (2000m).
steps.expected: The OBU starts the Overlap timer. The timer is regarded as started (state 'running'), even though the timeout is infinite.

test_cases.title: Overlap timer timeout consequences
test_cases.preconditions: The Overlap timer is running. The MA includes an overlap with an associated release speed. The EOA has a non-zero target speed.
test_cases.test_inputs: Overlap timer timeout value set to 5 seconds for test purposes.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU allows observation of the overlap status, release speed, Supervised Location, and target speed at EOA.

steps.action: Wait for the Overlap timer to exceed the timeout value.
steps.expected: The OBU deletes the overlap and its associated release speed. The Supervised Location is redetermined per SUBSET-026 §3.8.4.5. Location-based information per Appendix A.3.4 is deleted. The target speed at the End of Movement Authority is set to zero.

test_cases.title: Overlap timer expiration upon train standstill
test_cases.preconditions: The Overlap timer is running. The train is moving within the overlap area.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train speed reduced to 0 km/h.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU allows observation of the Overlap timer state and the application of timeout consequences.

steps.action: Bring the train to a complete standstill while the Overlap timer is running.
steps.expected: The OBU treats the Overlap timer as expired. The consequences defined for Overlap time-out in SUBSET-026 §3.8.4.4.2 are applied (overlap deleted, SvL redetermined, target speed at EOA set to zero).

test_cases.title: Overlap timer timeout upon receiving MA with rear start location
test_cases.preconditions: No Overlap timer is currently running. The train's max safe front end is at position 1500m. A new MA is received with an Overlap timer start location at 1000m (rear of the max safe front end).
test_cases.test_inputs: New MA with Overlap timer start location at 1000m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU allows observation of the Overlap timer state and the application of timeout consequences.

steps.action: Receive the new MA with the Overlap timer start location in rear of the max safe front end.
steps.expected: The OBU considers that the Overlap timer has exceeded its time-out value. The consequences defined in SUBSET-026 §3.8.4.4.2 are applied.

test_cases.title: Supervised Location determination with active overlap
test_cases.preconditions: The MA includes an overlap that has not timed out. A Danger Point and an End Section are also defined in the MA.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA with Overlap end at 3000m, Danger Point at 2500m, End Section end at 2000m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU provides a diagnostic interface to observe the current Supervised Location (SvL).

steps.action: Check the Supervised Location (SvL) while the overlap is active and has not timed out.
steps.expected: The OBU takes the end of the overlap (3000m) as the Supervised Location.

test_cases.title: Supervised Location determination with no overlap but Danger Point
test_cases.preconditions: The MA does not include an overlap (or the overlap has timed out). A Danger Point is defined in the MA. An End Section is also defined.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA with Danger Point at 2500m, End Section end at 2000m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU provides a diagnostic interface to observe the current Supervised Location (SvL).

steps.action: Check the Supervised Location (SvL) when no active overlap exists but a Danger Point is present.
steps.expected: The OBU takes the Danger Point (2500m) as the Supervised Location.

test_cases.title: Supervised Location determination with no overlap or Danger Point
test_cases.preconditions: The MA does not include an overlap (or it has timed out) and does not define a Danger Point. An End Section is defined in the MA.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA with End Section end at 2000m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU provides a diagnostic interface to observe the current Supervised Location (SvL).

steps.action: Check the Supervised Location (SvL) when neither an active overlap nor a Danger Point exists.
steps.expected: The OBU takes the end of the End Section (2000m) as the Supervised Location.

test_cases.title: Infill MA evaluation in Full Supervision

steps.expected: The OBU evaluates the infill MA.

test_cases.assumptions: The OBU provides a diagnostic interface to observe whether the infill MA is evaluated.

steps.action: Receive an infill MA while in Automatic Driving mode.

test_cases.title: Infill MA evaluation in Limited Supervision
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Limited Supervision mode. Linking information is available for the main signal balise group.

steps.action: Receive an infill MA while in Limited Supervision mode.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates the infill MA.

test_cases.title: Infill MA rejection in other modes
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode other than Full Supervision, Automatic Driving, or Limited Supervision (e.g., Supervision mode or Standstill). Linking information is available.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill MA message received.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU provides a diagnostic interface to observe whether the infill MA is evaluated.

steps.action: Receive an infill MA while in a mode not listed in the requirement (e.g., Supervision).
steps.expected: The OBU does not evaluate the infill MA.

test_cases.title: Infill MA evaluation with available linking information
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode. Linking information is available for the main signal balise group to which the infill MA refers.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill MA message received.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU provides a diagnostic interface to observe whether the infill MA is evaluated.

steps.action: Receive an infill MA when linking information is available.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates the infill MA.

test_cases.title: Infill MA rejection without linking information
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode. Linking information is NOT available for the main signal balise group to which the infill MA refers.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill MA message received.
