steps.expected: The OBU does not evaluate the infill MA.

test_cases.title: Replacement of previous MA data upon receiving a new MA from RBC
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode and has an active MA (MA_old) with specific data (e.g., speed profile, end position).
test_cases.test_inputs: A new MA (MA_new) transmitted by the RBC with different data than MA_old.

steps.action: Receive MA_old and verify OBU stores its data.
steps.expected: OBU supervises the movement according to MA_old data.

steps.action: Receive MA_new from the RBC.
steps.expected: OBU replaces all data of MA_old with the data from MA_new.

steps.action: Check the stored MA data in OBU.
steps.expected: The stored MA data matches MA_new completely, and no data from MA_old remains.

test_cases.title: Replacement of previous MA data upon receiving a new MA from main-signal balise group
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode and has an active MA (MA_old).
test_cases.test_inputs: A new MA (MA_new) received from a main-signal balise group (non-infill information).

steps.action: Receive MA_old and verify OBU stores its data.
steps.expected: OBU supervises the movement according to MA_old data.

steps.action: Receive MA_new from a main-signal balise group.
steps.expected: OBU replaces all data of MA_old with the data from MA_new.

steps.action: Check the stored MA data in OBU.
steps.expected: The stored MA data matches MA_new completely.

test_cases.title: Partial replacement of MA data upon receiving infill information
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode and has an active MA (MA_old) that ends at a main signal with a balise group.
test_cases.test_inputs: An infill MA (MA_infill) that provides data beyond the announced balise group at the next main signal.

steps.action: Receive MA_old and verify OBU stores its data up to the next main signal balise group.
steps.expected: OBU supervises the movement according to MA_old data.

steps.action: Receive MA_infill (infill information).
steps.expected: OBU replaces only the data beyond the announced balise group at the next main signal with the data from MA_infill.

steps.action: Check the stored MA data in OBU.
steps.expected: Data up to the next main signal balise group remains from MA_old, and data beyond that point is updated with MA_infill data.

test_cases.title: Start of new MA section at infill location reference
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode and has an active MA ending at a main signal with a balise group.
test_cases.test_inputs: An infill MA with a location reference pointing to the balise group at the next main signal.

steps.action: Receive the infill MA.
steps.expected: OBU identifies the infill location reference as the balise group at the next main signal.

steps.action: Verify the start of the new MA section.
steps.expected: OBU starts a new MA section at the infill location reference (the balise group at the next main signal).

test_cases.title: Treatment of new MA with SvL as MA shortening while supervising LOA
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is supervising a Level of Authority (LOA) and has stored location-based information as per SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.4.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new MA defining a Supervision Limit (SvL) where the SvL is located before the current LOA end.

steps.action: Receive the new MA defining an SvL while OBU is supervising an LOA.
steps.expected: OBU treats the new MA as an MA shortening.

steps.action: Check the stored location-based information.
steps.expected: OBU deletes the stored location-based information listed in SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.4 accordingly.

test_cases.title: Treatment of new MA with SvL as MA shortening regardless of SvL position
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is supervising a Level of Authority (LOA) and has stored location-based information as per SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.4.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new MA defining an SvL where the SvL is located after the current LOA end.

steps.action: Receive the new MA defining an SvL while OBU is supervising an LOA.
steps.expected: OBU treats the new MA as an MA shortening, even though the SvL is beyond the current LOA.

steps.action: Check the stored location-based information.
steps.expected: OBU deletes the stored location-based information listed in SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.4 accordingly.

test_cases.title: Repositioning information not treated as MA shortening
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode with an active MA.
test_cases.test_inputs: Repositioning information received by the OBU.

steps.action: Receive repositioning information.
steps.expected: OBU does not treat the reception of repositioning information as an MA shortening.

steps.action: Verify the MA status.
steps.expected: The current MA remains unchanged and is not shortened.

test_cases.title: New MA ending with LOA not treated as MA shortening
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode with an active MA.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new MA that ends with a Level of Authority (LOA).

steps.action: Receive a new MA ending with an LOA.
steps.expected: OBU does not treat the reception of this new MA as an MA shortening.

steps.action: Verify the MA status.
steps.expected: The current MA is updated with the new MA data but is not considered shortened.

test_cases.title: Adoption of shortened MA when train is behind Indication supervision limit
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a mode where MA management is active (e.g., Full Supervision). The current MA is active. The train front end position is known and is located behind the Indication supervision limit of the proposed shortened MA.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC request to shorten MA containing: New MA ID, New Mode Profile, New SH-area balise group list (if applicable), Indication supervision limit position.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can simulate or receive a valid RBC message for MA shortening. The train position is controllable or can be set to a specific value relative to the Indication supervision limit.

steps.action: Send an RBC request to shorten the MA where the Indication supervision limit is ahead of the current train front end position.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the request.

steps.action: Check the OBU's internal state for the active MA, mode profile, and SH-area balise group list.
steps.expected: The OBU has adopted the proposed shortened MA, its mode profile, and the SH-area balise group list (if provided).

steps.action: Monitor the communication channel for the OBU's response to the RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a message to the RBC informing it of the decision to adopt the shortened MA.

test_cases.title: Rejection of shortened MA when train is ahead of Indication supervision limit
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a mode where MA management is active. The current MA is active. The train front end position is known and is located ahead of (or at) the Indication supervision limit of the proposed shortened MA.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC request to shorten MA containing: New MA ID, New Mode Profile, New SH-area balise group list (if applicable), Indication supervision limit position behind the train front end.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can simulate or receive a valid RBC message for MA shortening. The train position is controllable or can be set to a specific value relative to the Indication supervision limit.

steps.action: Send an RBC request to shorten the MA where the Indication supervision limit is behind the current train front end position.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the request.

steps.action: Check the OBU's internal state for the active MA, mode profile, and SH-area balise group list.
steps.expected: The OBU retains the previous MA, mode profile, and SH-area balise group list. The new MA is not adopted.

steps.action: Monitor the communication channel for the OBU's response to the RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a message to the RBC informing it of the decision to reject the shortened MA.

test_cases.title: Boundary condition: Train front end exactly at Indication supervision limit
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a mode where MA management is active. The current MA is active. The train front end position is set exactly at the Indication supervision limit of the proposed shortened MA.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC request to shorten MA containing: New MA ID, New Mode Profile, New SH-area balise group list (if applicable), Indication supervision limit position equal to the train front end position.
test_cases.assumptions: The requirement states 'in rear of' for adoption. Therefore, being exactly at the limit is not 'in rear of'. The OBU should reject the request. This test verifies the boundary interpretation.

steps.action: Send an RBC request to shorten the MA where the Indication supervision limit is exactly at the current train front end position.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the request, as the train is not in rear of the limit.

steps.action: Check the OBU's internal state for the active MA, mode profile, and SH-area balise group list.
steps.expected: The OBU retains the previous MA, mode profile, and SH-area balise group list.

steps.action: Monitor the communication channel for the OBU's response to the RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a message to the RBC informing it of the decision to reject the shortened MA.

test_cases.title: OBU'nun desteklemediği infill medium talebinin yok sayılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, desteklenen infill transmission medium listesine sahip olarak yapılandırılmıştır. OBU, geçerli bir balise grubundan önceki operasyonel durumu (hız, konum, sinyal bilgisi) almıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Desteklenmeyen bir infill transmission medium (örneğin, OBU'da bulunmayan bir frekans bandı veya protokol) talep eden bir announcement balise grubu.
test_cases.assumptions: OBU'nun desteklemediği bir medium türünün (örneğin 'Medium X') tanımlı olduğu ve OBU'nun bu mediumu desteklemediği varsayılır.

steps.action: OBU'ya, desteklenmeyen bir infill transmission medium talep eden bir announcement balise grubu sinyali verilir.
steps.expected: OBU, bu talebi yok sayar (ignore). OBU'da hata alarmı veya durum değişikliği oluşmaz.

steps.action: OBU'nun mevcut operasyonel durumu gözlemlenir.
steps.expected: OBU, balise grubundan önceki durumuna göre çalışmaya devam eder. Hız, konum ve sinyal bilgileri kesintiye uğramaz.

test_cases.title: Desteklenmeyen medium talebinden sonra OBU'nun stabil çalışması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, desteklenmeyen bir infill medium talebini yok saymıştır ve önceki durumuna göre çalışmaktadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: OBU'nun desteklediği standart balise verileri.

steps.action: Desteklenmeyen medium talebinden sonra, OBU'ya desteklenen standart balise verileri iletilir.
steps.expected: OBU, yeni gelen geçerli verileri işler ve operasyonel durumunu günceller.

steps.action: OBU'nun çalışması izlenir.
steps.expected: OBU, kesintisiz ve tutarlı bir şekilde çalışmaya devam eder. Desteklenmeyen medium talebinin etkisi kalmaz.

test_cases.title: OBU reads next main signal balise group and ignores subsequent loop infill
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode and has not yet read the next main signal balise group. A loop antenna is present and capable of transmitting infill information.
test_cases.test_inputs: 1. Main signal balise group data for the next signal. 2. Infill information packet from the loop antenna.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU is configured to accept infill information from loops before reading the main signal balise group.

steps.action: Transmit infill information from the loop antenna to the OBU before the main signal balise group is read.
steps.expected: The OBU processes and stores the infill information as valid data.

steps.action: Simulate the OBU reading the next main signal balise group.
steps.expected: The OBU registers the read of the main signal balise group.

steps.action: Transmit additional infill information from the loop antenna after the main signal balise group has been read.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the new infill information and does not update its state with this data.

test_cases.title: OBU detects missed main signal balise group and ignores subsequent loop infill
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. The next main signal balise group is expected but not physically present or readable (simulated miss). A loop antenna is present.
test_cases.test_inputs: 1. Infill information packet from the loop antenna. 2. Trigger for missed balise detection logic.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU has a defined mechanism to detect that a main signal balise group was missed (e.g., based on distance traveled or time).

steps.action: Transmit infill information from the loop antenna to the OBU before the missed balise detection is triggered.
steps.expected: The OBU processes and stores the infill information as valid data.

steps.action: Trigger the OBU's detection logic to confirm that the next main signal balise group was missed.
steps.expected: The OBU registers the missed main signal balise group.

steps.action: Transmit additional infill information from the loop antenna after the missed balise detection.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the new infill information and does not update its state with this data.

test_cases.title: GSM-R yokken RIU oturum emrinin yok sayılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU üzerinde GSM-R radyo sistemi kurulu değildir. Balise grubu üzerinden RIU ile iletişim oturumu kurma emri gönderilebilir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise grubu emri: RIU ile oturum kurma.

steps.action: Balise grubu üzerinden RIU ile iletişim oturumu kurma emri gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, emri yok sayar ve RIU ile herhangi bir iletişim oturumu başlatmaz.

test_cases.title: Emredilen RIU ile oturumun kurulması ve diğer oturumun sonlandırılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, RIU-A ile aktif bir iletişim oturumuna sahiptir. Balise grubu, RIU-B ile oturum kurma emrini ve konum bilgisini içerir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise grubu emri: RIU-B ile oturum kur, konum: X.
test_cases.assumptions: OBU, yeni bir oturum işleyebildiğinde mevcut oturumu sonlandırabilir.

steps.action: OBU, emirde belirtilen konuma (X) ulaşır.
steps.expected: OBU, RIU-A ile olan mevcut oturumu sonlandırır.

steps.action: OBU, yeni bir oturum işleme kapasitesine sahip olur.
steps.expected: OBU, RIU-B ile iletişim oturumu kurar.

test_cases.title: Degrade durumda RIU üzerinden gelen oturum emrinin yok sayılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, GSM-R üzerinden yalnızca tek bir iletişim oturumu işleyebilmektedir (degrade durum). Mevcut GSM-R oturumu aktif.
test_cases.test_inputs: RIU üzerinden gelen emir: RIU-C ile oturum kur.

steps.action: RIU üzerinden RIU-C ile iletişim oturumu kurma emri gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, emri yok sayar ve RIU-C ile oturum başlatmaz.

test_cases.title: Infill alanına girişte ve sonraki balise grubu okunmasında bilgi gönderimi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, RIU ile aktif oturumdadır. Balise grubu emri, infill alanı giriş konumu ve sonraki ana sinyal balise grubu (BG-N) kimliğini içerir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise grubu emri: Giriş konumu: Y, Sonraki BG: BG-N.

steps.action: OBU, emirde belirtilen giriş konumunu (Y) geçer.
steps.expected: OBU, RIU'ya bilgi gönderir.

steps.action: OBU, BG-N balise grubunu okur.
steps.expected: OBU, RIU'ya bilgi gönderir.

test_cases.title: Sonraki balise grubunun kaçırılması durumunda bilgi gönderimi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, RIU ile aktif oturumdadır. Balise grubu emri, infill alanı giriş konumu ve sonraki ana sinyal balise grubu (BG-N) kimliğini içerir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise grubu emri: Giriş konumu: Y, Sonraki BG: BG-N.
test_cases.assumptions: BG-N balise grubu fiziksel olarak okunamamaktadır (kaçırılmış).

steps.action: OBU, giriş konumunu (Y) geçer.
steps.expected: OBU, RIU'ya bilgi gönderir.

steps.action: OBU, BG-N balise grubunun kaçırıldığını tespit eder.
steps.expected: OBU, RIU'ya bilgi gönderir.

test_cases.title: RIU'ya gönderilen bilginin içeriği
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, RIU ile aktif oturumdadır ve bilgi gönderme tetikleyicisi (giriş konumu veya balise okuma) gerçekleşmiştir.
test_cases.assumptions: Gönderilen mesaj içeriği yakalanabilir ve analiz edilebilir.

steps.action: OBU, RIU'ya bilgi gönderir.
steps.expected: Mesaj, tren kimliğini (ETCS-ID), konum raporunu, sonraki ana sinyal balise grubu kimliğini ve zaman damgasını içerir.

test_cases.title: RIU verisi tutarlılık kontrolü
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, RIU ile aktif oturumdadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Tutarlı olmayan RIU verisi (SUBSET-026 §3.16.3.1 ve §3.16.3.3 ilkelerine aykırı).
test_cases.assumptions: Tutarlı olmayan veri, örneğin geçersiz konum veya zaman damgası tutarsızlığı olarak simüle edilir.

steps.action: RIU'dan tutarlı olmayan veri gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, verinin tutarsızlığını tespit eder ve SUBSET-026 ilkelerine göre uygun hata işleme prosedürünü uygular (örneğin veriyi reddetme veya hata durumu bildirme).

test_cases.title: Balise grubu okunduktan sonra ilgili RIU bilgilerinin yok sayılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, RIU ile aktif oturumdadır. BG-N balise grubu okunmuştur veya kaçırıldığı tespit edilmiştir.
test_cases.test_inputs: BG-N ile ilgili ek RIU bilgisi.

steps.action: BG-N ile ilgili ek RIU bilgisi gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, bu ek bilgileri yok sayar.

test_cases.title: Balise grubu emriyle RIU oturumunun sonlandırılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, RIU ile aktif oturumdadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise grubu emri: RIU oturumunu sonlandır.

steps.action: Balise grubu üzerinden RIU oturumunu sonlandırma emri gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, RIU ile iletişim oturumunu sonlandırır.

test_cases.title: RIU emriyle RIU oturumunun sonlandırılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, RIU ile aktif oturumdadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: RIU emri: Oturumu sonlandır.

steps.action: RIU üzerinden oturumu sonlandırma emri gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, RIU ile iletişim oturumunu sonlandırır.

test_cases.title: Level 1'den çıkışta RIU oturumunun sonlandırılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, Level 1'de çalışmaktadır ve RIU ile aktif oturumdadır.

steps.action: OBU, Level 1'den çıkar (örneğin Level 2'ye geçiş veya Level 0'a düşüş).
steps.expected: OBU, RIU ile iletişim oturumunu sonlandırır.

test_cases.title: Emergency message acknowledgement with correct ID
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a state where it can receive emergency messages (e.g., Operational or Standby).
test_cases.test_inputs: A valid emergency message with a unique identification number (e.g., 12345).

steps.action: Send an emergency message with identification number 12345 to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU receives the message.

steps.action: Monitor the OBU's response.
steps.expected: The OBU sends an acknowledgement message that quotes the identification number 12345.

test_cases.title: Acknowledgement of multiple distinct emergency messages
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a state where it can receive emergency messages.
test_cases.test_inputs: Two distinct emergency messages with identification numbers 1001 and 1002.

steps.action: Send an emergency message with identification number 1001 to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU sends an acknowledgement quoting ID 1001.

steps.action: Send a second emergency message with identification number 1002 to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU sends an acknowledgement quoting ID 1002.

test_cases.title: Emergency stop active: New MA rejected
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode and has accepted a valid emergency stop message. The emergency stop is currently active (not revoked).
test_cases.test_inputs: A valid new Movement Authority (MA) message.

steps.action: Transmit a valid new Movement Authority (MA) to the OBU while the emergency stop is active.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the new Movement Authority. The OBU does not update its movement authority state.

test_cases.title: Emergency stop revoked: New MA accepted
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode and has accepted a valid emergency stop message. The emergency stop is currently active.
test_cases.test_inputs: A valid emergency stop revocation message, followed by a valid new Movement Authority (MA) message.

steps.action: Transmit a valid emergency stop revocation message to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the revocation. The emergency stop state is cleared.

steps.action: Transmit a valid new Movement Authority (MA) to the OBU after the revocation.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the new Movement Authority. The OBU updates its movement authority state accordingly.

test_cases.title: Emergency stop active: Invalid MA rejected
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode and has accepted a valid emergency stop message. The emergency stop is currently active.
test_cases.test_inputs: An invalid or malformed Movement Authority (MA) message.

steps.action: Transmit an invalid or malformed Movement Authority (MA) to the OBU while the emergency stop is active.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the message. The OBU does not update its movement authority state.

test_cases.title: Emergency message revocation acknowledgement
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode and has previously received and acknowledged an emergency message. The RBC is configured to send a revocation for this specific emergency message.
test_cases.test_inputs: Emergency message revocation message from RBC.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU is correctly configured to communicate with the RBC. The emergency message ID in the revocation matches the previously received message.

steps.action: Send an emergency message revocation from the RBC to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU receives the revocation message.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's response to the RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU sends an acknowledgement message to the RBC confirming the receipt of the revocation, in accordance with SUBSET-026 §3.16.3.5.

steps.action: Check the OBU's internal state regarding the emergency message.
steps.expected: The emergency message is no longer active or displayed on the OBU.

test_cases.title: On-Sight modunda ray kenarı hız limitinin ulusal ve varsayılan değerlere önceliği
test_cases.preconditions: ETC On-Sight modundadır. Ulusal hız limiti ve varsayılan hız limiti tanımlıdır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Ray kenarı hız limiti: 80 km/h, Ulusal hız limiti: 100 km/h, Varsayılan hız limiti: 120 km/h.
test_cases.assumptions: Hız limitleri geçerli aralıklardadır ve ETC'ye doğru iletilmektedir.

steps.action: Ray kenarı tarafından 80 km/h hız limiti gönderilir.
steps.expected: ETC, uygulanan hız limitini 80 km/h olarak ayarlar.

steps.action: ETC'nin uyguladığı hız limiti kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Uygulanan hız limiti, ulusal (100 km/h) ve varsayılan (120 km/h) değerlerden düşük olan ray kenarı değerine (80 km/h) eşittir.

test_cases.title: Limited Supervision modunda ray kenarı hız limitinin önceliği
test_cases.preconditions: ETC Limited Supervision modundadır. Ulusal ve varsayılan hız limitleri tanımlıdır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Ray kenarı hız limiti: 60 km/h, Ulusal hız limiti: 90 km/h, Varsayılan hız limiti: 110 km/h.
test_cases.assumptions: Hız limitleri geçerli aralıklardadır.

steps.action: Ray kenarı tarafından 60 km/h hız limiti gönderilir.
steps.expected: ETC, uygulanan hız limitini 60 km/h olarak ayarlar.

steps.action: ETC'nin uyguladığı hız limiti kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Uygulanan hız limiti, ulusal (90 km/h) ve varsayılan (110 km/h) değerlere göre ray kenarı değerine (60 km/h) önceliklidir.

test_cases.title: Shunting modunda ray kenarı hız limitinin önceliği
test_cases.preconditions: ETC Shunting modundadır. Ulusal ve varsayılan hız limitleri tanımlıdır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Ray kenarı hız limiti: 40 km/h, Ulusal hız limiti: 50 km/h, Varsayılan hız limiti: 60 km/h.
test_cases.assumptions: Hız limitleri geçerli aralıklardadır.

steps.action: Ray kenarı tarafından 40 km/h hız limiti gönderilir.
steps.expected: ETC, uygulanan hız limitini 40 km/h olarak ayarlar.

steps.action: ETC'nin uyguladığı hız limiti kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Uygulanan hız limiti, ulusal (50 km/h) ve varsayılan (60 km/h) değerlere göre ray kenarı değerine (40 km/h) önceliklidir.

test_cases.title: Ray kenarı hız limitinin ulusal ve varsayılandan yüksek olması durumu
test_cases.preconditions: ETC On-Sight modundadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Ray kenarı hız limiti: 150 km/h, Ulusal hız limiti: 100 km/h, Varsayılan hız limiti: 120 km/h.
test_cases.assumptions: Ray kenarı limiti, modun izin verdiği maksimum hızı aşmıyorsa geçerli kabul edilir. Öncelik kuralı mutlak hız değerinden bağımsız olarak ray kenarı verisine aittir.

steps.action: Ray kenarı tarafından 150 km/h hız limiti gönderilir.
steps.expected: ETC, uygulanan hız limitini 150 km/h olarak ayarlar.

steps.action: ETC'nin uyguladığı hız limiti kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Uygulanan hız limiti, ulusal (100 km/h) ve varsayılan (120 km/h) değerlerden yüksek olan ray kenarı değerine (150 km/h) eşittir.

test_cases.title: PBD verisi alındığında hız kısıtlamasının hesaplanması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, ray kenarı tarafından gönderilen geçerli izin verilen frenleme mesafesi (PBD) verisini almaya hazırdır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Ray kenarından gelen PBD verisi paketi.
test_cases.assumptions: OBU'nun iç hız kısıtlama göstergesi veya log kaydı gözlemlenebilir.

steps.action: Ray kenarı, OBU'ya izin verilen frenleme mesafesi verisini gönderir.
steps.expected: OBU, izin verilen frenleme mesafesini sağlamak için gerekli hız kısıtlamasını hesaplar ve bu değeri iç hız kısıtlaması olarak uygular.

test_cases.title: Girdi değişmediğinde yeniden hesaplamanın yapılmaması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, PBD verisini almış ve hız kısıtlamasını hesaplamıştır. Hesaplama girdileri (SUBSET-026 §3.11.11) sabittir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Değişmeyen PBD verisi ve sabit girdi parametreleri.
test_cases.assumptions: Hesaplama tetikleyicileri veya işlem logları gözlemlenebilir.

steps.action: Hesaplama girdilerinden herhangi birini değiştirmeden, OBU'ya aynı PBD verisi tekrar gönderilir veya sistem bekletilir.
steps.expected: OBU, hız kısıtlamasını yeniden hesaplamaz; mevcut hız kısıtlama değeri korunur.

test_cases.title: Girdi değiştiğinde yeniden hesaplamanın yapılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, PBD verisini almış ve hız kısıtlamasını hesaplamıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Değiştirilmiş PBD verisi veya değişen bir hesaplama girdisi (örneğin eğim veya araç parametresi).
test_cases.assumptions: Hesaplama tetikleyicileri veya işlem logları gözlemlenebilir.

steps.action: Hesaplama girdilerinden biri (örneğin izin verilen frenleme mesafesi değeri) değiştirilir.
steps.expected: OBU, değişen girdiye dayanarak hız kısıtlamasını yeniden hesaplar ve yeni değeri uygular.

test_cases.title: Hesaplama varsayımlarının (SUBSET-026 §3.11.11.4) uygulanması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, PBD verisini almaya hazırdır. SUBSET-026 §3.11.11.4'te belirtilen varsayımlar (dönen kütle telafili eğim, güvenli yavaşlamalar, EBD eğrisi vb.) sisteme tanımlıdır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Bilinen PBD verisi ve SUBSET-026 §3.11.11.4 varsayımlarına göre önceden hesaplanmış beklenen hız kısıtlama değeri.
test_cases.assumptions: Beklenen hız kısıtlama değeri, SUBSET-026 §3.11.11.4'teki formüller ve varsayımlar kullanılarak bağımsız olarak hesaplanmıştır.

steps.action: OBU'ya PBD verisi gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU'nun hesapladığı hız kısıtlama değeri, SUBSET-026 §3.11.11.4'teki varsayımlar (dönen kütle telafili eğim, güvenli yavaşlamalar, EBD eğrisi, sıfır tahmini ivme, sabit hız hatası/gecikme varsayımları) kullanılarak bağımsız olarak hesaplanan beklenen değerle eşleşir.

test_cases.title: Acil frenle PBD hız kısıtlamasının hesaplanması (EBD eşitsizlikleri)
test_cases.preconditions: Ray kenarı, PBD'nin acil fren (EB) ile sağlanmasını gerektirir. OBU, EBD tabanlı eşitsizlikleri (SUBSET-026 §3.11.11.6) çözmeye hazırdır.
test_cases.test_inputs: EBD tabanlı eşitsizlikleri sağlayan bir hız aralığına sahip PBD verisi.
test_cases.assumptions: Beklenen hız kısıtlama değeri, SUBSET-026 §3.11.11.6'daki EBD eşitsizlikleri ve yuvarlama kuralı kullanılarak bağımsız olarak hesaplanmıştır.

steps.action: OBU'ya, acil frenle sağlanması gereken PBD verisi gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, EBD tabanlı eşitsizlikleri sağlayan hızı hesaplar, bu hızı SUBSET-026 §3.11.11.6'da belirtildiği gibi aşağı yuvarlar ve bu değeri PBD hız kısıtlaması olarak uygular.

test_cases.title: EBD eşitsizliklerini sağlayan hız yoksa kısıtlamanın sıfır olması
test_cases.preconditions: Ray kenarı, PBD'nin acil frenle sağlanmasını gerektirir.
test_cases.test_inputs: EBD tabanlı eşitsizlikleri sağlayan hiçbir hızın olmadığı bir PBD verisi (örneğin çok kısa frenleme mesafesi veya aşırı eğim).
test_cases.assumptions: Sistem, bu durumda hız kısıtlamasını sıfır olarak ayarlamalıdır.

steps.action: OBU'ya, EBD eşitsizliklerini sağlayan bir hızın olmadığı PBD verisi gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, PBD hız kısıtlamasını sıfır olarak hesaplar ve uygular.

test_cases.title: Tunnel stopping area start evaluation with estimated front end
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. A tunnel stopping area is defined in the track database. The train is approaching the tunnel stopping area.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train position data such that the estimated front end is just before the start of the tunnel stopping area.
test_cases.assumptions: The estimated front end position is calculated correctly by the OBU based on the train length and current position.

steps.action: Move the train so that the estimated front end is 1 meter before the start of the tunnel stopping area.
steps.expected: The OBU does not evaluate the start of the tunnel stopping area as active.

steps.action: Move the train so that the estimated front end is exactly at the start of the tunnel stopping area.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates the start of the tunnel stopping area as active.

steps.action: Move the train so that the estimated front end is 1 meter after the start of the tunnel stopping area.
steps.expected: The OBU continues to evaluate the start of the tunnel stopping area as active.

test_cases.title: Tunnel stopping area end evaluation with estimated front end
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. A tunnel stopping area is defined in the track database. The train is inside the tunnel stopping area.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train position data such that the estimated front end is approaching the end of the tunnel stopping area.
test_cases.assumptions: The estimated front end position is calculated correctly by the OBU based on the train length and current position.

steps.action: Move the train so that the estimated front end is 1 meter before the end of the tunnel stopping area.
steps.expected: The OBU does not evaluate the end of the tunnel stopping area as reached.

steps.action: Move the train so that the estimated front end is exactly at the end of the tunnel stopping area.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates the end of the tunnel stopping area as reached.

steps.action: Move the train so that the estimated front end is 1 meter after the end of the tunnel stopping area.
steps.expected: The OBU no longer evaluates the tunnel stopping area as active.

test_cases.title: Sound horn track condition start evaluation with estimated front end
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. A sound horn track condition is defined in the track database. The train is approaching the sound horn track condition.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train position data such that the estimated front end is just before the start of the sound horn track condition.
test_cases.assumptions: The estimated front end position is calculated correctly by the OBU based on the train length and current position.

steps.action: Move the train so that the estimated front end is 1 meter before the start of the sound horn track condition.
steps.expected: The OBU does not evaluate the start of the sound horn track condition as active.

steps.action: Move the train so that the estimated front end is exactly at the start of the sound horn track condition.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates the start of the sound horn track condition as active.

steps.action: Move the train so that the estimated front end is 1 meter after the start of the sound horn track condition.
steps.expected: The OBU continues to evaluate the start of the sound horn track condition as active.

test_cases.title: Sound horn track condition end evaluation with estimated front end
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. A sound horn track condition is defined in the track database. The train is inside the sound horn track condition.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train position data such that the estimated front end is approaching the end of the sound horn track condition.
test_cases.assumptions: The estimated front end position is calculated correctly by the OBU based on the train length and current position.

steps.action: Move the train so that the estimated front end is 1 meter before the end of the sound horn track condition.
steps.expected: The OBU does not evaluate the end of the sound horn track condition as reached.

steps.action: Move the train so that the estimated front end is exactly at the end of the sound horn track condition.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates the end of the sound horn track condition as reached.

steps.action: Move the train so that the estimated front end is 1 meter after the end of the sound horn track condition.
steps.expected: The OBU no longer evaluates the sound horn track condition as active.

test_cases.title: Route suitability check: Loading gauge mismatch
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on and in operational mode. Train Data is configured with a specific loading gauge (e.g., Gauge A).
test_cases.test_inputs: Route suitability data from trackside permitting only Gauge B.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU interface allows injection of simulated trackside route suitability data.

steps.action: Inject route suitability data from trackside that does not include the train's configured loading gauge.
steps.expected: The OBU compares the data with stored Train Data and identifies an unsuitability.

steps.action: Observe the OBU status or driver display.
steps.expected: The OBU indicates that the route is unsuitable due to loading gauge mismatch.

test_cases.title: Route suitability check: Axle load category mismatch
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on and in operational mode. Train Data is configured with a specific axle load category (e.g., Category 1).
test_cases.test_inputs: Route suitability data from trackside permitting only Axle Load Category 2.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU interface allows injection of simulated trackside route suitability data.

steps.action: Inject route suitability data from trackside that does not include the train's configured axle load category.
steps.expected: The OBU compares the data with stored Train Data and identifies an unsuitability.

steps.action: Observe the OBU status or driver display.
steps.expected: The OBU indicates that the route is unsuitable due to axle load category mismatch.

steps.action: Inject route suitability data from trackside that does not include the train's configured traction system.
steps.expected: The OBU compares the data with stored Train Data and identifies an unsuitability.

steps.action: Observe the OBU status or driver display.
steps.expected: The OBU indicates that the route is unsuitable due to traction system mismatch.

test_cases.title: Route suitability check: All parameters match

test_cases.test_inputs: Route suitability data from trackside that includes all the train's configured parameters.

steps.action: Inject route suitability data from trackside that includes the train's loading gauge, axle load category, and traction system.

test_cases.title: Traction system check: Engine capable of running without traction

steps.expected: The OBU does not report a traction system unsuitability.

steps.expected: The OBU reports a traction system unsuitability.

test_cases.title: No route suitability data: Train allowed to run

test_cases.test_inputs: None (absence of data).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU interface allows simulation of a state where no route suitability data is provided by trackside.

steps.expected: The OBU is in a state where no route suitability restriction exists.

steps.action: Observe the OBU status or driver display.
steps.expected: The OBU allows the train to run and does not apply any default route suitability values.

test_cases.assumptions: The OBU interface allows verification of the initial state after power-on.

steps.action: Power on the OBU and wait for initialization to complete.
steps.expected: The OBU reaches its initial state.

steps.action: Check the OBU's internal state for route suitability restrictions.
steps.expected: The OBU's initial state indicates that no route suitability restriction exists.

test_cases.title: Display appearance for auxiliary information without acknowledgement
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode and connected to RBC.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside text message with class 'auxiliary information' and 'driver acknowledgement not requested'.
test_cases.assumptions: The specific visual appearance (e.g., font, color, position) for this combination is defined in the OBU HMI specification.

steps.action: Send a trackside text message with class 'auxiliary information' and 'driver acknowledgement not requested' to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU displays the message with the appearance defined for auxiliary information without acknowledgement.

test_cases.title: Display appearance for important information with acknowledgement
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode and connected to RBC.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside text message with class 'important information' and 'driver acknowledgement requested'.
test_cases.assumptions: The specific visual appearance (e.g., font, color, position) for this combination is defined in the OBU HMI specification.

steps.action: Send a trackside text message with class 'important information' and 'driver acknowledgement requested' to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU displays the message with the appearance defined for important information with acknowledgement.

test_cases.title: Start condition fulfilled by one of multiple sub-conditions (OR logic)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside text message with two start sub-conditions (e.g., location and speed) defined with 'OR' logic (either one fulfilled).
test_cases.assumptions: The trackside message explicitly defines the logic as 'either one' (OR).

steps.action: Configure the OBU to satisfy only the first start sub-condition (e.g., reach the start location) while the second (e.g., speed) is not met.
steps.expected: The OBU considers the start condition fulfilled and displays the message.

test_cases.title: Start condition fulfilled by all of multiple sub-conditions (AND logic)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside text message with two start sub-conditions (e.g., location and speed) defined with 'AND' logic (all fulfilled).
test_cases.assumptions: The trackside message explicitly defines the logic as 'all' (AND).

steps.action: Configure the OBU to satisfy only the first start sub-condition (e.g., reach the start location) while the second (e.g., speed) is not met.
steps.expected: The OBU does not consider the start condition fulfilled and does not display the message.

steps.action: Configure the OBU to satisfy the second start sub-condition (e.g., reach required speed) while the first is still met.
steps.expected: The OBU considers the start condition fulfilled and displays the message.

test_cases.title: Start condition fulfilled immediately when no sub-conditions defined
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside text message with no start sub-conditions defined.

steps.action: Send a trackside text message with no start sub-conditions to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU treats the start condition as fulfilled immediately and displays the message (assuming end condition is not yet fulfilled).

test_cases.title: Driver acknowledgement ends display regardless of end condition
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is displaying a text message that requests driver confirmation.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside text message with 'driver acknowledgement requested' and defined as 'acknowledgement always ends display'. End condition is not yet fulfilled.

steps.action: Driver acknowledges the displayed text message.
steps.expected: The OBU stops displaying the message immediately, even though the end condition is not fulfilled.

test_cases.title: Driver acknowledgement is necessary but not sufficient to end display
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is displaying a text message that requests driver confirmation.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside text message with 'driver acknowledgement requested' and defined as 'acknowledgement is necessary condition in addition to end condition'. End condition is not yet fulfilled.

steps.action: Driver acknowledges the displayed text message.
steps.expected: The OBU continues to display the message because the end condition is not yet fulfilled.

steps.action: Fulfill the end condition of the message.
steps.expected: The OBU stops displaying the message.

test_cases.title: Message not displayed if end condition already fulfilled at start
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside text message where the end condition is already fulfilled at the moment the start condition is fulfilled.

steps.action: Send a trackside text message such that its end condition is already fulfilled when the start condition becomes fulfilled.
steps.expected: The OBU does not display the message at all.

test_cases.title: Display length measured from start location regardless of other start sub-conditions
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside text message with start condition including location and another sub-condition (e.g., speed), and end condition using location sub-condition.
test_cases.assumptions: The display length is defined by the distance between the start location and the end location.

steps.action: Fulfill the start condition (both location and speed) and observe the display.
steps.expected: The OBU displays the message for the length defined by the distance from the start location to the end location, regardless of the speed sub-condition.

test_cases.title: Driver acknowledgement report sent to RBC
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is displaying a text message that requests a report of driver acknowledgement.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside text message with 'report of driver acknowledgement requested' and a specific text message identifier.

steps.action: Driver acknowledges the displayed text message.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a driver acknowledgement report to the RBC referenced in the request, including the text message identifier.

test_cases.title: Reject new text message with same identifier as unacknowledged message
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has received a text message requesting a report of driver acknowledgement, which has not yet been acknowledged by the driver.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new trackside text message requesting a report of driver acknowledgement with the same text message identifier as the earlier unacknowledged message.

steps.action: Send a new trackside text message requesting a report of driver acknowledgement with the same text message identifier as the earlier unacknowledged message.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the newly received text message.

test_cases.title: Infill MA ile OS/LS Mode Profile'ın referans noktası ötesinde silinmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, izlenen bir OS/LS Mode Profile'ı aktif olarak izlemektedir. Infill referans konumu, Mode Profile'ın başlangıcının ötesindedir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill referans konumunun ötesinde uzanan bir OS/LS Mode Profile'ı içeren yeni bir MA (infill).
test_cases.assumptions: Infill referans konumu, Mode Profile'ın başlangıç noktasından ileri bir konumda kabul edilir.

steps.action: Infill referans konumunun ötesinde uzanan bir OS/LS Mode Profile'ı içeren yeni bir MA (infill) OBU'ya iletilir.
steps.expected: OBU, izlenen Mode Profile'ı tamamen silmez. Sadece infill referans konumunun ötesindeki OS/LS Mode Profile verilerini siler.

steps.action: OBU'nun mevcut Mode Profile durumu kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Infill referans konumunun arkasındaki (öncesindeki) Mode Profile verileri korunur ve OBU bu bölge için izlemeye devam eder.

test_cases.title: Infill referansı başlangıçta veya arkadaysa izlenen SH Mode Profile'ın silinmesi

test_cases.test_inputs: Infill referans konumu, SH Mode Profile'ın başlangıcında veya arkasında olan yeni bir MA (infill).
test_cases.assumptions: SH Mode Profile'ın başlangıç konumu ve infill referans konumu arasındaki ilişki, referansın başlangıçta veya arkasında olduğu şekilde ayarlanır.

steps.action: Infill referans konumu, izlenen SH Mode Profile'ın başlangıç noktasında veya arkasında olacak şekilde yeni bir MA (infill) OBU'ya iletilir.
steps.expected: OBU, izlenen SH Mode Profile'ı siler.

steps.action: OBU'nun Mode Profile izleme durumu kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: SH Mode Profile'ı artık izlenmez ve ilgili veriler OBU'dan kaldırılır.

test_cases.title: Infill referansı başlangıcın ötesindeyse izlenen SH Mode Profile'ın korunması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, izlenen bir SH (Supervised) Mode Profile'ı aktif olarak izlemektedir. Infill referans konumu, SH Mode Profile'ın başlangıç noktasının ötesindedir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill referans konumu, SH Mode Profile'ın başlangıcının ötesinde olan ve yeni bir Mode Profile ile SH balise grubu listesi içeren MA (infill).
test_cases.assumptions: Infill MA, yeni bir Mode Profile ve SH balise grubu listesi içerir.

steps.action: Infill referans konumu, izlenen SH Mode Profile'ın başlangıç noktasının ötesinde olacak şekilde yeni bir MA (infill) OBU'ya iletilir.
steps.expected: OBU, mevcut izlenen SH Mode Profile'ı silmez ve korur.

steps.action: Infill MA'daki yeni Mode Profile ve SH balise grubu listesi OBU tarafından işlenir.
steps.expected: OBU, infill MA'daki yeni Mode Profile ve SH balise grubu listesini yok sayar (ignore eder).
