test_cases.title: LX information replacement with same identity
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a state where it can receive LX information. An initial LX message with Identity ID 'A' and Data 'D1' has been successfully received and stored.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new LX message with Identity ID 'A' and Data 'D2' (where D2 is different from D1).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU provides a means to inspect the currently stored LX information for a given identity.

steps.action: Send the new LX message with Identity ID 'A' and Data 'D2' to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the message.

steps.action: Inspect the stored LX information for Identity ID 'A'.
steps.expected: The stored data is 'D2'. The previous data 'D1' is no longer present.

test_cases.title: LX information replacement with identical content
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has stored LX information with Identity ID 'B' and Data 'D3'.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new LX message with Identity ID 'B' and Data 'D3' (identical to the stored data).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU provides a means to inspect the currently stored LX information for a given identity.

steps.action: Send the new LX message with Identity ID 'B' and Data 'D3' to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the message.

steps.action: Inspect the stored LX information for Identity ID 'B'.
steps.expected: The stored data remains 'D3'. The system state is consistent with the received information.

test_cases.title: Phishing-resistant authentication option availability at AAL2
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account is registered and configured for AAL2 authentication.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid company representative credentials.
test_cases.assumptions: The system is configured to support at least one phishing-resistant method (e.g., FIDO2/WebAuthn) as per NIST SP 800-63B-4 §3.2.5.

steps.action: Navigate to the login page for the company representative portal.
steps.expected: The login interface displays at least one authentication option that is phishing-resistant (e.g., 'Sign in with Security Key' or 'Use Biometric/Passkey').

steps.action: Select the phishing-resistant authentication option and complete the authentication process using a valid registered device.
steps.expected: The system successfully authenticates the user and grants access to the portal, confirming the method is functional and meets AAL2 requirements.

test_cases.title: Authentication with Multi-Factor Authenticator
test_cases.preconditions: A valid company representative account exists with AAL2 access rights. A multi-factor authenticator (e.g., TOTP app or hardware token) is registered and active for the account.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid username, valid password, valid one-time code from the multi-factor authenticator.
test_cases.assumptions: The system supports standard multi-factor authenticators as defined in NIST SP 800-63B-4.

steps.action: Navigate to the login page and enter the valid username and password.
steps.expected: The system accepts the credentials and prompts for the second factor (multi-factor authenticator code).

steps.action: Enter the valid one-time code generated by the registered multi-factor authenticator.
steps.expected: The system authenticates the user successfully and grants access to the portal.

test_cases.title: Authentication with Two Separate Factors
test_cases.preconditions: A valid company representative account exists with AAL2 access rights. The account is configured to use two separate authentication factors (e.g., password and SMS OTP) instead of a single multi-factor authenticator.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid username, valid password, valid SMS one-time code.
test_cases.assumptions: The system allows configuration of two separate factors as an alternative to a multi-factor authenticator, compliant with NIST SP 800-63B-4 §2.2.1.

steps.action: Navigate to the login page and enter the valid username and password.
steps.expected: The system accepts the credentials and sends a one-time code via the second factor channel (e.g., SMS).

steps.action: Enter the valid one-time code received via the second factor.
steps.expected: The system authenticates the user successfully and grants access to the portal.

test_cases.title: Authentication Failure with Invalid Second Factor
test_cases.preconditions: A valid company representative account exists with AAL2 access rights. A multi-factor authenticator is registered for the account.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid username, valid password, invalid one-time code.

steps.action: Navigate to the login page and enter the valid username and password.
steps.expected: The system accepts the credentials and prompts for the second factor.

steps.action: Enter an invalid one-time code.
steps.expected: The system rejects the authentication attempt and displays an error message indicating the second factor is invalid.

test_cases.title: Authentication Failure with Missing Second Factor
test_cases.preconditions: A valid company representative account exists with AAL2 access rights. A multi-factor authenticator is registered for the account.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid username, valid password, empty second factor field.

steps.action: Navigate to the login page and enter the valid username and password.
steps.expected: The system accepts the credentials and prompts for the second factor.

steps.action: Submit the form without entering a second factor code.
steps.expected: The system rejects the authentication attempt and displays an error message indicating the second factor is required.

test_cases.title: Inactivity timeout triggers reauthentication for AAL2 session
test_cases.preconditions: A citizen or company representative is logged in with an active AAL2 session. The inactivity timeout value is defined in VBP SDD §14.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid AAL2 credentials.
test_cases.assumptions: The inactivity timeout duration is set to a testable value (e.g., 5 minutes) in the test environment configuration.

steps.action: Log in with valid AAL2 credentials to establish a session.
steps.expected: The user is authenticated and the session is active.

steps.action: Wait for the inactivity timeout duration defined in VBP SDD §14 to elapse without any user interaction.
steps.expected: The system detects the inactivity and initiates the reauthentication process.

steps.action: Provide valid AAL2 credentials when prompted for reauthentication.
steps.expected: The session is re-authenticated and remains active.

test_cases.title: Overall timeout triggers reauthentication for AAL2 session
test_cases.preconditions: A citizen or company representative is logged in with an active AAL2 session. The overall timeout value is defined in VBP SDD §14.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid AAL2 credentials.
test_cases.assumptions: The overall timeout duration is set to a testable value (e.g., 30 minutes) in the test environment configuration.

steps.action: Log in with valid AAL2 credentials to establish a session.
steps.expected: The user is authenticated and the session is active.

steps.action: Perform periodic user interactions to prevent inactivity timeout, but wait for the overall timeout duration defined in VBP SDD §14 to elapse.
steps.expected: The system detects the overall timeout and initiates the reauthentication process.

steps.action: Provide valid AAL2 credentials when prompted for reauthentication.
steps.expected: The session is re-authenticated and remains active.

test_cases.title: Failed reauthentication after inactivity timeout
test_cases.preconditions: A citizen or company representative is logged in with an active AAL2 session. The inactivity timeout value is defined in VBP SDD §14.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid AAL2 credentials for initial login, invalid credentials for reauthentication.
test_cases.assumptions: The inactivity timeout duration is set to a testable value in the test environment configuration.

steps.action: Log in with valid AAL2 credentials to establish a session.
steps.expected: The user is authenticated and the session is active.

steps.action: Wait for the inactivity timeout duration to elapse without any user interaction.
steps.expected: The system initiates the reauthentication process.

steps.action: Provide invalid AAL2 credentials when prompted for reauthentication.
steps.expected: The reauthentication fails, and the session is terminated or locked according to system policy.

test_cases.title: Notification sent to representative upon account recovery
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists and is in a recoverable state. The representative's contact details are valid and active.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid recovery credentials for the company representative account.
test_cases.assumptions: The notification channel (e.g., email) is monitored and functional. NIST SP 800-63B-4 §4.2.3 specifies that the notification must be sent to the account holder.

steps.action: Initiate the account recovery process for the company representative account using valid recovery credentials.
steps.expected: The system successfully processes the recovery request and restores access to the account.

steps.action: Check the notification channel (e.g., email inbox) associated with the company representative account.
steps.expected: A notification message is received indicating that the account has been recovered.

test_cases.title: Notification sent to designee upon account recovery
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists. A designee has been previously authorized and registered in the system to receive notifications for this account. The designee's contact details are valid and active.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid recovery credentials for the company representative account.
test_cases.assumptions: The system supports designee configuration as per NIST SP 800-63B-4 §4.2.3. The designee's contact information is correctly stored in the system.

steps.action: Initiate the account recovery process for the company representative account using valid recovery credentials.
steps.expected: The system successfully processes the recovery request and restores access to the account.

steps.action: Check the notification channel (e.g., email inbox) associated with the authorized designee.
steps.expected: A notification message is received by the designee indicating that the company representative account has been recovered.

test_cases.title: Electronic notification addresses receive account notifications
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with at least one valid email address and one valid phone number registered as notification addresses.
test_cases.test_inputs: A valid company representative account with registered email and phone notification addresses.
test_cases.assumptions: The system is configured to send notifications via email and SMS as per NIST SP 800-63B-4 §4.6.

steps.action: Trigger an account notification event (e.g., password change or new login) for the company representative account.
steps.expected: The system generates a notification for the account event.

steps.action: Check the inbox of the registered email address.
steps.expected: An account notification email is received at the registered email address.

steps.action: Check the SMS log or device of the registered phone number.
steps.expected: An account notification SMS is received at the registered phone number.

test_cases.title: Postal addresses do not receive account notifications
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with a postal address registered as a notification address, and no other electronic notification addresses (email/phone) are registered.
test_cases.test_inputs: A valid company representative account with only a postal address registered as a notification address.
test_cases.assumptions: The system distinguishes between postal and electronic notification addresses.

steps.action: Trigger an account notification event (e.g., password change or new login) for the company representative account.
steps.expected: The system generates a notification for the account event.

steps.action: Verify that no electronic notification (email or SMS) is sent.
steps.expected: No email or SMS is sent, as the only registered address is postal.

steps.action: Check the system logs for notification dispatch attempts.
steps.expected: The logs indicate that the postal address was excluded from electronic notification dispatch.

test_cases.title: All registered electronic notification addresses receive notifications
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with multiple valid email addresses and phone numbers registered as notification addresses.
test_cases.test_inputs: A valid company representative account with multiple registered email and phone notification addresses.
test_cases.assumptions: The system supports multiple notification addresses per account.

steps.action: Trigger an account notification event for the company representative account.
steps.expected: The system generates a notification for the account event.

steps.action: Check the inbox of each registered email address.
steps.expected: An account notification email is received at each registered email address.

steps.action: Check the SMS log or device of each registered phone number.
steps.expected: An account notification SMS is received at each registered phone number.

test_cases.title: VBP oturumunun e-Devlet assertion geçerlilik süresinden bağımsızlığı
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcının e-Devlet üzerinden başarılı bir kimlik doğrulaması yapılmış ve VBP oturumu başlatılmıştır. VBP oturum süresi, e-Devlet assertion geçerlilik süresinden uzundur.
test_cases.test_inputs: Geçerli e-Devlet assertion'ı içeren bir oturum.
test_cases.assumptions: VBP oturum süresi, e-Devlet assertion geçerlilik süresinden en az 10 dakika uzundur.

steps.action: e-Devlet assertion geçerlilik süresi dolana kadar VBP'de beklenir.
steps.expected: VBP oturumu devam eder, kullanıcı oturumdan atılmaz.

steps.action: e-Devlet assertion geçerlilik süresi dolduktan sonra VBP'de bir işlem yapılır.
steps.expected: İşlem başarıyla tamamlanır, oturum geçerli kalır.

test_cases.title: Federation transaction initiation includes VBP identifier and nonce
test_cases.preconditions: VBP is configured with a valid identifier for e-Devlet federation. A valid user session is established in VBP.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid user credentials for VBP.
test_cases.assumptions: Network traffic between VBP and e-Devlet can be intercepted or logged for inspection.

steps.action: Initiate a federation transaction from VBP to e-Devlet.
steps.expected: VBP sends an assertion request to e-Devlet.

steps.action: Inspect the assertion request payload sent by VBP.
steps.expected: The request contains a field identifying VBP and a cryptographic nonce value.

test_cases.title: Assertion request nonce is unique per transaction
test_cases.preconditions: VBP is configured for federation with e-Devlet.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid user credentials for VBP.
test_cases.assumptions: Multiple federation transactions can be initiated in succession.

steps.action: Initiate a first federation transaction and record the nonce value in the assertion request.
steps.expected: A nonce value N1 is present in the request.

steps.action: Initiate a second federation transaction and record the nonce value in the assertion request.
steps.expected: A nonce value N2 is present in the request, and N2 is different from N1.

test_cases.title: VBP audience identifier validation in e-Devlet assertion
test_cases.preconditions: VBP is configured with a unique audience identifier. A valid e-Devlet session is established.
test_cases.test_inputs: A valid e-Devlet assertion where the 'aud' claim contains the VBP identifier.
test_cases.assumptions: The e-Devlet IdP is configured to include the VBP identifier in the audience claim for VBP requests.

steps.action: Submit a login request to VBP using a valid e-Devlet assertion that includes the VBP identifier in the audience claim.
steps.expected: VBP accepts the assertion and establishes a user session.

test_cases.title: Rejection of assertion with missing VBP audience identifier
test_cases.preconditions: VBP is configured with a unique audience identifier.
test_cases.test_inputs: A valid e-Devlet assertion where the 'aud' claim does not contain the VBP identifier (e.g., contains only a different RP identifier or is empty).
test_cases.assumptions: The test environment allows injection of crafted assertions for security testing.

steps.action: Submit a login request to VBP using an e-Devlet assertion where the audience claim does not contain the VBP identifier.
steps.expected: VBP rejects the assertion, denies access, and logs a security error indicating audience mismatch.

test_cases.title: Rejection of assertion intended for a different RP
test_cases.preconditions: VBP is configured with a unique audience identifier. A valid e-Devlet assertion generated for a different RP (RP-B) is available.
test_cases.test_inputs: A valid e-Devlet assertion where the 'aud' claim contains the identifier for RP-B but not VBP.
test_cases.assumptions: The assertion is cryptographically valid and signed by the e-Devlet IdP, but intended for a different service.

steps.action: Submit a login request to VBP using the e-Devlet assertion generated for RP-B.
steps.expected: VBP rejects the assertion, denies access, and logs a security error indicating the assertion is not intended for VBP.

test_cases.title: Setting a new phone number triggers authenticator binding process
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with a pre-registered telephone number. The user is authenticated.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new valid telephone number.
test_cases.assumptions: The system implements the NIST SP 800-63B-4 §4.1.2 binding process, which typically involves sending a one-time code to the new number and verifying it.

steps.action: Navigate to the profile settings and select the option to change the pre-registered telephone number.
steps.expected: The system initiates the authenticator binding process (e.g., prompts for a new number and sends a verification code to the new number) rather than simply saving the number.

steps.action: Enter the new telephone number and submit the request.
steps.expected: The system sends a one-time code to the new telephone number and waits for verification.

steps.action: Enter the correct one-time code received on the new telephone number.
steps.expected: The system verifies the code, completes the binding process, and updates the pre-registered telephone number to the new one.

test_cases.title: Changing phone number without verification fails
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with a pre-registered telephone number. The user is authenticated.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new valid telephone number, an incorrect one-time code.
test_cases.assumptions: The binding process requires successful verification of a code sent to the new number.

steps.action: Initiate the change of the pre-registered telephone number to a new number.
steps.expected: The system sends a one-time code to the new number.

steps.action: Enter an incorrect one-time code.
steps.expected: The system rejects the code, displays an error message, and does not update the pre-registered telephone number.

steps.action: Check the current pre-registered telephone number in the profile.
steps.expected: The original pre-registered telephone number remains unchanged.

test_cases.title: Setting phone number for a new representative triggers binding
test_cases.preconditions: A company account exists. A new company representative is being added or is updating their profile for the first time.
test_cases.test_inputs: A valid telephone number for the new representative.
test_cases.assumptions: The 'setting' of a pre-registered number for a new representative is treated as binding a new authenticator.

steps.action: Provide a telephone number for the new company representative during the registration or profile setup.
steps.expected: The system treats this as an authenticator binding event and sends a verification code to the provided number.

steps.action: Verify the code sent to the telephone number.
steps.expected: The telephone number is successfully bound as the pre-registered number for the representative.

test_cases.title: Binding a second authenticator to a company representative account
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with one active authenticator bound.
test_cases.test_inputs: Credentials for the company representative account; details for a new authenticator (e.g., a new TOTP secret or hardware key).
test_cases.assumptions: The system supports at least two authenticators per account as per NIST SP 800-63B-4 §4.1.2.1.

steps.action: Log in to the company representative account using the existing authenticator.
steps.expected: The user is successfully authenticated and redirected to the account security settings.

steps.action: Navigate to the authenticator management section and initiate the binding of a new authenticator.
steps.expected: The system displays the interface for adding a new authenticator (e.g., QR code for TOTP or prompt for hardware key).

steps.action: Complete the binding process for the new authenticator by providing the required verification (e.g., entering the TOTP code or touching the hardware key).
steps.expected: The system confirms the successful binding of the new authenticator.

steps.action: View the list of bound authenticators for the account.
steps.expected: The list displays both the original authenticator and the newly bound authenticator as active.

test_cases.title: Binding a third authenticator to a company representative account
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with two active authenticators bound.
test_cases.test_inputs: Credentials for the company representative account; details for a third new authenticator.
test_cases.assumptions: The system allows more than two authenticators to be bound, consistent with 'multiple' in the requirement.

steps.action: Log in to the company representative account using one of the existing authenticators.
steps.expected: The user is successfully authenticated.

steps.action: Initiate the binding of a third authenticator.
steps.expected: The system allows the addition of a new authenticator without error.

steps.action: Complete the binding process for the third authenticator.
steps.expected: The system confirms the successful binding.

steps.action: View the list of bound authenticators.
steps.expected: The list displays all three authenticators as active.

test_cases.title: Attempting to bind an authenticator to a non-representative account
test_cases.preconditions: A standard citizen account (non-representative) exists.
test_cases.test_inputs: Credentials for the standard citizen account.
test_cases.assumptions: The requirement specifically mentions 'company representative account', implying this feature may be restricted to that role. If the system allows it for all, this test case should be adjusted or removed, but based on strict reading, we test the boundary of the specified role.

steps.action: Log in to the standard citizen account.
steps.expected: The user is successfully authenticated.

steps.action: Attempt to access the multi-authenticator binding feature if available in the UI, or attempt to bind a second authenticator.
steps.expected: If the feature is restricted to company representatives, the option is not visible or the action is rejected with an appropriate error message. If the feature is available to all users, the binding succeeds (note: this would indicate the requirement is broader than the text suggests, but the test verifies the behavior for the specified role type).

test_cases.title: Authentication required at lower AAL when account max is lower than authenticator max
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with a maximum available AAL of AAL2. A new authenticator capable of AAL3 is ready to be bound.
test_cases.test_inputs: Account credentials for AAL2, New AAL3 authenticator details.
test_cases.assumptions: The system supports AAL1, AAL2, and AAL3. The 'maximum AAL currently available in the account' is determined by the highest AAL of existing bound authenticators or account policy.

steps.action: Initiate the process to bind a new AAL3 authenticator to the account.
steps.expected: The system prompts for authentication.

steps.action: Provide authentication credentials corresponding to AAL2.
steps.expected: The authentication is accepted, and the new authenticator is successfully bound to the account.

test_cases.title: Authentication required at lower AAL when authenticator max is lower than account max
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with a maximum available AAL of AAL3. A new authenticator capable of AAL2 is ready to be bound.
test_cases.test_inputs: Account credentials for AAL3, New AAL2 authenticator details.
test_cases.assumptions: The system supports AAL1, AAL2, and AAL3.

steps.action: Initiate the process to bind a new AAL2 authenticator to the account.
steps.expected: The system prompts for authentication.

steps.action: Provide authentication credentials corresponding to AAL2.
steps.expected: The authentication is accepted, and the new authenticator is successfully bound to the account.

test_cases.title: Authentication rejected if provided AAL is lower than the required lower bound
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with a maximum available AAL of AAL2. A new authenticator capable of AAL3 is ready to be bound. The required AAL is AAL2.
test_cases.test_inputs: Account credentials for AAL1, New AAL3 authenticator details.
test_cases.assumptions: The system supports AAL1, AAL2, and AAL3.

steps.action: Initiate the process to bind a new AAL3 authenticator to the account.
steps.expected: The system prompts for authentication.

steps.action: Provide authentication credentials corresponding to AAL1.
steps.expected: The authentication is rejected. An error message indicating insufficient authentication level is displayed.

test_cases.title: Authentication required at AAL1 when both account and authenticator max are AAL1
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with a maximum available AAL of AAL1. A new authenticator capable of AAL1 is ready to be bound.
test_cases.test_inputs: Account credentials for AAL1, New AAL1 authenticator details.
test_cases.assumptions: The system supports AAL1, AAL2, and AAL3.

steps.action: Initiate the process to bind a new AAL1 authenticator to the account.
steps.expected: The system prompts for authentication.

steps.action: Provide authentication credentials corresponding to AAL1.
steps.expected: The authentication is accepted, and the new authenticator is successfully bound to the account.

test_cases.title: Notification sent via independent channel upon authenticator addition
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists and is active. The representative has a valid email address or phone number registered for out-of-band notifications. The system is configured to send notifications via a channel independent of the transaction (e.g., SMS or Email) as per NIST SP 800-63B-4 §4.1.2.1.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid company representative credentials. A new authenticator device (e.g., TOTP app or hardware key) to be added.
test_cases.assumptions: The 'independent mechanism' is defined as SMS or Email, distinct from the web session where the authenticator is added. The notification content includes a confirmation of the new authenticator binding.

steps.action: Log in to the VBP portal using the company representative account.
steps.expected: The user is successfully authenticated and redirected to the dashboard or security settings page.

steps.action: Navigate to the security settings and initiate the process to add a new authenticator.
steps.expected: The system displays the QR code or setup instructions for the new authenticator.

steps.action: Complete the setup of the new authenticator on the device and confirm the addition in the portal.
steps.expected: The system confirms that the new authenticator has been successfully bound to the account.

steps.action: Check the independent notification channel (e.g., SMS inbox or Email inbox) associated with the representative's account.
steps.expected: A notification message is received indicating that a new authenticator has been added to the account. The message is sent via a channel different from the web session used to add the authenticator.

test_cases.title: Notification not sent if authenticator addition fails
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists. The independent notification channel is monitored.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid company representative credentials. An invalid or expired authenticator setup code.
test_cases.assumptions: The system only sends the notification upon successful binding of the authenticator.

steps.action: Log in to the VBP portal using the company representative account.
steps.expected: The user is successfully authenticated.

steps.action: Initiate the process to add a new authenticator and enter an invalid or expired setup code.
steps.expected: The system displays an error message indicating that the authenticator could not be added.

steps.action: Check the independent notification channel (e.g., SMS inbox or Email inbox).
steps.expected: No notification regarding the addition of a new authenticator is received.

test_cases.title: Kullanılan e-posta onay kodunun geçersiz kılınması
test_cases.preconditions: Kayıt sürecinde şirket temsilcisi için e-posta onay kodu gönderilmiştir ve kod henüz kullanılmamıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Geçerli onay kodu.

steps.action: Gönderilen onay kodu sistemde doğrulanır.
steps.expected: Doğrulama başarılı olur ve kodun kullanıldığı kaydedilir.

steps.action: Aynı onay kodu, geçerlilik süresi (60 dakika) dolmadan ikinci kez gönderilir.
steps.expected: Sistem kodu reddeder ve 'kod geçersiz' veya benzeri bir hata mesajı gösterir.

test_cases.title: SMS kodunun 5 dakika içinde doğrulanması
test_cases.preconditions: Şirket temsilcisi birinci faktörü (parola) başarıyla girmiştir ve SMS kodu gönderilmiştir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Doğru SMS kodu.

steps.action: SMS kodu gönderildikten sonra 5 dakikadan kısa bir süre içinde (ör. 1 dakika sonra) doğru kod girilir.
steps.expected: İkinci faktör doğrulaması başarılı olur ve kullanıcı oturum açar.

test_cases.title: SMS kodunun 5 dakikadan sonra reddedilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Şirket temsilcisi birinci faktörü (parola) başarıyla girmiştir ve SMS kodu gönderilmiştir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Doğru SMS kodu.
test_cases.assumptions: Sistem saati kontrol edilebilir veya test ortamında zaman manipülasyonu yapılabilir.

steps.action: SMS kodu gönderildikten sonra 5 dakikadan uzun bir süre beklenir (ör. 5 dakika 1 saniye).
steps.expected: Sistem hâlâ giriş ekranında bekler.

steps.action: Doğru SMS kodu girilir.
steps.expected: Sistem kodu reddeder, hata mesajı gösterir ve kullanıcı oturum açamaz.

test_cases.title: 15 karakterlik parolanın kabul edilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Şirket temsilcisi hesabı etkinleştirme veya parola değiştirme ekranındadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: 15 karakter uzunluğunda geçerli bir parola.

steps.action: 15 karakter uzunluğundaki parola girilir ve kaydedilir.
steps.expected: Sistem parolayı kabul eder ve başarı mesajı gösterir.

test_cases.title: 14 karakterlik parolanın reddedilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Şirket temsilcisi hesabı etkinleştirme veya parola değiştirme ekranındadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: 14 karakter uzunluğunda geçerli bir parola.

steps.action: 14 karakter uzunluğundaki parola girilir ve kaydedilmeye çalışılır.
steps.expected: Sistem parolayı reddeder, 'en az 15 karakter olmalı' hatası gösterir ve parola saklanmaz.

test_cases.title: 50. başarısız denemede kimlik doğrulayıcının devre dışı bırakılması
test_cases.preconditions: Aktif bir şirket temsilcisi hesabı vardır ve kimlik doğrulayıcı (parola) aktif durumdadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Yanlış parola.
test_cases.assumptions: Test ortamında 49 başarısız deneme önceden simüle edilmiş veya hızlıca yapılabilir.

steps.action: Aynı hesap için 49 kez yanlış parola ile giriş denemesi yapılır.
steps.expected: Her denemede hata mesajı gösterilir, hesap ve kimlik doğrulayıcı hâlâ aktiftir.

steps.action: 50. kez yanlış parola ile giriş denemesi yapılır.
steps.expected: Sistem kimlik doğrulayıcıyı (parolayı) devre dışı bırakır ve kullanıcıya bu durum bildirilir.

steps.action: Doğru parola ile giriş denemesi yapılır.
steps.expected: Giriş reddedilir, kimlik doğrulayıcı devre dışı olduğu için kimlik doğrulama yapılamaz.

test_cases.title: 5 dakikadan eski kimlik doğrulama ile e-posta değişikliğinin engellenmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Şirket temsilcisi oturum açmıştır ve son tam kimlik doğrulaması 5 dakikadan daha önce yapılmıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Yeni e-posta adresi.

steps.action: Hesap ayarlarından e-posta adresi değiştirme işlemine başlanır.
steps.expected: Sistem tam kimlik doğrulama gerektirdiğini bildirir ve değişikliği uygulamaz.

steps.action: Kullanıcı yeniden tam kimlik doğrulama yapar (parola + ikinci faktör).
steps.expected: Kimlik doğrulama başarılı olur.

steps.action: E-posta değişikliği işlemi tekrar denenir.
steps.expected: Sistem değişikliği kabul eder ve e-posta adresi güncellenir.

test_cases.title: 25. dakikada hareketsizlik uyarısının gösterilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Şirket temsilcisi AAL2 düzeyinde oturum açmıştır ve sistemde hareketsizlik zaman aşımı 30 dakikadır.
test_cases.assumptions: Sistem saati veya zamanlayıcı test için manipüle edilebilir.

steps.action: Kullanıcı 25 dakika boyunca hiçbir işlem yapmaz.
steps.expected: Ekranda erişilebilir bir iletişim kutusu açılır, kalan süre (5 dakika) gösterilir ve ekran okuyucu tarafından duyurulur.

steps.action: İletişim kutusundaki 'Süreyi Uzat' düğmesine tıklanır.
steps.expected: Hareketsizlik zamanlayıcısı sıfırlanır ve oturum devam eder.

test_cases.title: Uyarıdan sonra 120 saniye içinde uzatılmaması durumunda oturumun 30. dakikada sonlanması
test_cases.preconditions: 25. dakikada hareketsizlik uyarısı gösterilmiştir.
test_cases.assumptions: Sistem saati veya zamanlayıcı test için manipüle edilebilir.

steps.action: Uyarı gösterildikten sonra 120 saniye beklenir ve hiçbir işlem yapılmaz.
steps.expected: Uyarı kutusu hâlâ ekranda kalır veya kullanıcıya süre uzatma seçeneği sunulmaya devam eder, oturum henüz sonlanmaz.

steps.action: Toplam hareketsizlik süresi 30 dakikaya ulaşana kadar beklenir.
steps.expected: Oturum sonlandırılır ve kullanıcı giriş ekranına yönlendirilir.

test_cases.title: Kayıt aktarım hatasında otomatik uyarı gönderimi
test_cases.preconditions: Merkezi kayıt yönetim sistemi ile portal arasındaki bağlantı kesilebilir veya hata simüle edilebilir.
test_cases.assumptions: Uyarı altyapısı (e-posta/SMS) test ortamında izlenebilir.

steps.action: Kayıt üretimi veya aktarımı sırasında bir hata simüle edilir.
steps.expected: Sistem hatayı algılar.

steps.action: 15 dakika içinde uyarı gönderimi kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: KHGM SOME ve nöbetçi yöneticiye otomatik uyarı gönderilir.

test_cases.title: Oturum açmış kullanıcı için dakikada 120 istek sınırının aşılması
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcı oturum açmıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: 121 isteklik bir istek serisi.
test_cases.assumptions: Yüksek hacimli istekler otomatik bir araçla gönderilebilir.

test_cases.title: Başarısız doğrulama sonrası hata mesajının belirsiz olması

test_cases.title: Başarılı ve başarısız doğrulama yanıt sürelerinin karşılaştırılması

steps.expected: Doğrulama başarısız olur ve yanıt süresi T2 olarak kaydedilir.

steps.action: T1 ve T2 süreleri karşılaştırılır.
steps.expected: Süreler arasında istatistiksel olarak anlamlı bir fark yoktur; kullanıcı, süreden yararlanarak kaydın varlığını tahmin edemez.

test_cases.title: Doğrulama başarısız olduğunda ek hata detayının loglara yazılmaması (Kullanıcıya Dönüş)

test_cases.title: IAL2 Company Representative Proofing via Authoritative Source Comparison
test_cases.preconditions: A test user account is created with IAL2 assurance level. The user is identified as a company representative. The system is connected to a mock authoritative source (e.g., MERSIS or similar) containing valid core attributes for the user.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid government identifier (TCKN), valid company registration number, and other core attributes matching the authoritative source.
test_cases.assumptions: The authoritative source returns a positive match for the provided attributes.

steps.action: Initiate the proofing process for the company representative user at IAL2.
steps.expected: The system prompts for core attributes including government identifier and company details.

steps.action: Submit the valid government identifier and core attributes that match the authoritative source.
steps.expected: The system validates the attributes against the authoritative source and returns a success status.

steps.action: Check the user's assurance level status in the system.
steps.expected: The user's identity is marked as verified at IAL2.

test_cases.title: IAL2 Company Representative Proofing via Digital Signature Validation
test_cases.preconditions: A test user account is created with IAL2 assurance level. The user is identified as a company representative. A digitally signed evidence document (SUPERIOR evidence) is prepared with a valid issuer public key.
test_cases.test_inputs: A digitally signed evidence document containing core attributes, signed by a trusted issuer.
test_cases.assumptions: The issuer's public key is available in the system's trust store and the signature is cryptographically valid.

steps.action: Initiate the proofing process for the company representative user at IAL2.
steps.expected: The system accepts the upload or input of the digitally signed evidence document.

steps.action: Submit the digitally signed evidence document.
steps.expected: The system validates the digital signature using the issuer's public key and extracts the core attributes.

steps.action: Check the user's assurance level status in the system.
steps.expected: The user's identity is marked as verified at IAL2 based on the validated digital signature.

test_cases.title: IAL2 Proofing Failure Due to Mismatched Attributes in Authoritative Source
test_cases.preconditions: A test user account is created with IAL2 assurance level. The user is identified as a company representative. The authoritative source contains different core attributes than those submitted.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid government identifier but incorrect company registration number or other core attributes that do not match the authoritative source.
test_cases.assumptions: The authoritative source returns a negative match for the provided attributes.

steps.action: Initiate the proofing process for the company representative user at IAL2.
steps.expected: The system prompts for core attributes.

steps.action: Submit core attributes that do not match the authoritative source.
steps.expected: The system fails the validation and displays an error message indicating the mismatch.

steps.action: Check the user's assurance level status in the system.
steps.expected: The user's identity is not verified at IAL2.

test_cases.title: IAL2 Proofing Failure Due to Invalid Digital Signature
test_cases.preconditions: A test user account is created with IAL2 assurance level. The user is identified as a company representative. A digitally signed evidence document is prepared with an invalid or tampered signature.
test_cases.test_inputs: A digitally signed evidence document with an invalid signature or a signature from an untrusted issuer.
test_cases.assumptions: The system detects the invalid signature or untrusted issuer.

steps.action: Initiate the proofing process for the company representative user at IAL2.
steps.expected: The system accepts the upload or input of the digitally signed evidence document.

steps.action: Submit the digitally signed evidence document with an invalid signature.
steps.expected: The system fails the signature validation and displays an error message indicating the invalid signature.

steps.action: Check the user's assurance level status in the system.
steps.expected: The user's identity is not verified at IAL2.

test_cases.title: Doğrulanmamış adres durumunda bildirim davranışı
test_cases.preconditions: Sistemde doğrulanmamış bir e-posta adresi ile ilişkilendirilmiş bir şirket temsilcisi hesabı vardır.

test_cases.title: Company representative identity verification does not use knowledge-based methods
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account is registered in the system. The user is logged in and has navigated to the identity verification step.
test_cases.test_inputs: A valid company representative user account.
test_cases.assumptions: The system provides a UI or API endpoint for identity verification that lists available verification methods.

steps.action: Initiate the identity verification process for the company representative account.
steps.expected: The system presents verification options. Knowledge-based verification (e.g., security questions, password-based challenges) is not listed as an available option.

steps.action: Attempt to select or trigger a knowledge-based verification method via the user interface or API if hidden.
steps.expected: The system rejects the request or the option is not selectable. The system proceeds only with non-knowledge-based verification methods (e.g., biometric, document upload, or out-of-band token).

test_cases.title: Knowledge-based verification is not accepted for company representative proofing
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account is registered. The identity verification step is active.
test_cases.test_inputs: A request payload or form submission attempting to use a knowledge-based verification method (e.g., answering a security question).
test_cases.assumptions: The system API or backend logic can be tested directly to ensure that even if the UI hides the option, the backend does not accept knowledge-based verification for this user type.

steps.action: Submit an identity verification request for a company representative using a knowledge-based method (e.g., providing an answer to a security question) via the API or backend interface.
steps.expected: The system rejects the verification attempt with an error indicating that knowledge-based verification is not supported or allowed for company representatives.

steps.action: Check the system logs or response status for the rejected request.
steps.expected: The response status indicates failure (e.g., 400 Bad Request or 403 Forbidden) and the error message explicitly states that the verification method is invalid for this user type.

test_cases.title: Email-based out-of-band authentication is not offered
test_cases.preconditions: A registered user account exists in the system.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid user credentials.

steps.action: Navigate to the login page and initiate the authentication process for a registered user.
steps.expected: The system presents only the primary authentication method (e.g., password or biometric) and does not offer an option to receive a one-time code via email for out-of-band authentication.

steps.action: Check the account security settings for the registered user.
steps.expected: There is no option to enable or configure email-based out-of-band authentication factors.

test_cases.title: SMS code generation does not reset failed authentication count
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with a valid phone number registered for SMS authentication. The account is not locked.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid company representative credentials, valid phone number.
test_cases.assumptions: The system allows generating a new SMS code after a failed authentication attempt without requiring a full re-login or password reset.

steps.action: Attempt to log in with an incorrect password for the company representative account.
steps.expected: The login fails, and the failed authentication count for the account is incremented to 1.

steps.action: Initiate the process to generate a new SMS one-time code for the same account.
steps.expected: A new SMS one-time code is generated and sent to the registered phone number.

steps.action: Check the current failed authentication count for the account in the system logs or database.
steps.expected: The failed authentication count remains 1 and has not been reset to 0.

test_cases.title: SMS code generation after multiple failures preserves count
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists. The account has 4 failed authentication attempts recorded (assuming a lockout threshold of 5, though the specific threshold is not defined in the requirement, the count must be preserved regardless).
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid company representative credentials, valid phone number.
test_cases.assumptions: The account is not yet locked. The system tracks failed attempts up to a certain limit before locking, but the requirement specifically states that SMS generation should not reset the count.

steps.action: Verify that the account currently has 4 failed authentication attempts recorded.
steps.expected: The system confirms the failed authentication count is 4.

steps.action: Initiate the process to generate a new SMS one-time code for the account.
steps.expected: A new SMS one-time code is generated and sent.

steps.action: Check the current failed authentication count for the account.
steps.expected: The failed authentication count remains 4 and has not been reset to 0.

test_cases.title: Password with only lowercase letters is accepted

test_cases.test_inputs: A password consisting only of lowercase letters (e.g., 'abcdefghij') that meets the minimum length requirement and is not on the blocklist.
test_cases.assumptions: The minimum password length is 8 characters as per standard NIST SP 800-63B-4 recommendations, unless specified otherwise in the project context. The password is not a common password.

steps.action: Navigate to the password change or registration screen for the company representative.
steps.expected: The password input field is available and ready for input.

steps.action: Enter the password consisting only of lowercase letters.
steps.expected: The system accepts the input without displaying any error regarding character composition (e.g., no requirement for uppercase, numbers, or special characters).

steps.action: Submit the form to save the password.
steps.expected: The password is successfully updated, and a success message is displayed.

test_cases.title: Password with only numbers is accepted

test_cases.test_inputs: A password consisting only of digits (e.g., '12345678') that meets the minimum length requirement and is not on the blocklist.
test_cases.assumptions: The password is not a common password (e.g., '12345678' might be on a blocklist, so a less common sequence like '98765432' is used).

steps.action: Navigate to the password change screen.
steps.expected: The password input field is available.

steps.action: Enter the password consisting only of digits.
steps.expected: The system accepts the input without displaying any error regarding character composition.

steps.action: Submit the form to save the password.
steps.expected: The password is successfully updated.

test_cases.title: Password with only special characters is accepted
test_cases.preconditions: A valid company representative account exists.
test_cases.test_inputs: A password consisting only of special characters (e.g., '!@#$%^&*') that meets the minimum length requirement and is not on the blocklist.
test_cases.assumptions: The password is not a common password.

steps.action: Navigate to the password change screen.
steps.expected: The password input field is available.

steps.action: Enter the password consisting only of special characters.
steps.expected: The system accepts the input without displaying any error regarding character composition.

steps.action: Submit the form to save the password.
steps.expected: The password is successfully updated.

test_cases.title: Password with mixed characters but no specific class is accepted
test_cases.preconditions: A valid company representative account exists.
test_cases.test_inputs: A password containing a mix of lowercase letters and spaces (e.g., 'hello world') that meets the minimum length requirement and is not on the blocklist.
test_cases.assumptions: The password is not a common password.

steps.action: Navigate to the password change screen.
steps.expected: The password input field is available.

steps.action: Enter the password containing lowercase letters and spaces.
steps.expected: The system accepts the input without displaying any error regarding character composition.

steps.action: Submit the form to save the password.
steps.expected: The password is successfully updated.

test_cases.title: ASCII password length validation
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists and is active.
test_cases.test_inputs: A password consisting of 12 ASCII characters (e.g., 'a1b2c3d4e5f6').
test_cases.assumptions: The minimum password length requirement is 12 characters.

steps.action: Set the password to a 12-character ASCII string.
steps.expected: The system accepts the password and reports the length as 12.

test_cases.title: Multibyte Unicode character length validation
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists and is active.
test_cases.test_inputs: A password consisting of 12 Unicode characters, including multibyte characters (e.g., 'a1b2c3d4e5f6' where 'f' is replaced by 'é' and '6' by 'ü', or a mix like 'P@sswörd1234').
test_cases.assumptions: The minimum password length requirement is 12 characters.

steps.action: Set the password to a 12-character Unicode string containing multibyte characters.
steps.expected: The system accepts the password and reports the length as 12, counting each code point as one character.

test_cases.title: Password length below minimum with Unicode characters
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists and is active.
test_cases.test_inputs: A password consisting of 11 Unicode characters, including multibyte characters.
test_cases.assumptions: The minimum password length requirement is 12 characters.

steps.action: Set the password to an 11-character Unicode string.
steps.expected: The system rejects the password, indicating that the length is insufficient (11 < 12).

test_cases.title: Password length at minimum boundary with Unicode characters
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists and is active.
test_cases.test_inputs: A password consisting of exactly 12 Unicode characters, including multibyte characters.
test_cases.assumptions: The minimum password length requirement is 12 characters.

steps.action: Set the password to a 12-character Unicode string.
steps.expected: The system accepts the password, confirming that 12 code points meet the minimum length requirement.

test_cases.title: Unauthenticated user cannot view password hint
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with a password hint set.
test_cases.test_inputs: URL of the password hint page or API endpoint.

steps.action: Access the password hint page or API endpoint without providing any authentication credentials.
steps.expected: The system denies access and does not display the password hint. A login prompt or 401/403 error is returned.

test_cases.title: Authenticated user can view their own password hint
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with a password hint set.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid credentials for the company representative.

steps.action: Log in to the portal using the valid credentials of the company representative.
steps.expected: The user is successfully authenticated.

steps.action: Navigate to the account settings or password management section where the hint is displayed.
steps.expected: The password hint set by the user is visible to the authenticated user.

test_cases.title: Şifre seçimi sırasında güvenlik sorusu istenmemesi
test_cases.preconditions: Sistemde şirket temsilcisi rolü için yeni bir hesap oluşturulması veya şifre sıfırlama işlemi başlatılmıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Geçerli bir şirket temsilcisi kimliği ve yeni bir şifre.

steps.action: Şirket temsilcisi rolüyle şifre oluşturma veya sıfırlama ekranına erişilir.
steps.expected: Sistem, kullanıcıdan 'ilk evcil hayvanın adı' veya benzeri bilgi tabanlı kimlik doğrulama soruları sormaz; yalnızca şifre alanlarını gösterir.

steps.action: Geçerli bir şifre girilerek işlem tamamlanır.
steps.expected: Şifre başarıyla kaydedilir ve güvenlik sorusu adımları atlanır.

test_cases.title: Tam parola doğrulaması (Normal)
test_cases.preconditions: Sistemde kayıtlı, uzunluğu 12 karakter olan bir şirket temsilcisi hesabı vardır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Kayıtlı 12 karakterlik parola.

steps.action: Şirket temsilcisi hesabı için parola doğrulama ekranına gidilir.
steps.expected: Parola giriş alanı, parolanın tamamını girmeye izin verir ve sadece bir alt kümesini (örneğin ilk 8 karakteri) kabul etmez.

steps.action: Kayıtlı 12 karakterlik parolanın tamamı girilir ve doğrulama yapılır.
steps.expected: Sistem parolanın tamamını kesmeden (truncation yapmadan) doğrular ve doğrulama başarılı olarak sonuçlanır.

test_cases.title: Parolanın alt kümesinin reddedilmesi (Hata)
test_cases.preconditions: Sistemde kayıtlı, uzunluğu 12 karakter olan bir şirket temsilcisi hesabı vardır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Kayıtlı parolanın ilk 8 karakteri.

steps.action: Şirket temsilcisi hesabı için parola doğrulama ekranına gidilir.
steps.expected: Parola giriş alanı aktiftir.

steps.action: Kayıtlı parolanın sadece ilk 8 karakteri (alt kümesi) girilir ve doğrulama yapılır.
steps.expected: Sistem parolanın tamamını doğruladığı için bu giriş geçersiz kabul edilir ve doğrulama başarısız olur.

test_cases.title: Uzun parolada kesinti olmaması (Sınır)
test_cases.preconditions: Sistemde kayıtlı, uzunluğu 64 karakter olan bir şirket temsilcisi hesabı vardır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Kayıtlı 64 karakterlik parola.
test_cases.assumptions: Sistem, NIST SP 800-63B-4 §3.1.1.2 gereksinimlerine uygun olarak 64 karakterlik parolaları desteklemektedir.

steps.action: Şirket temsilcisi hesabı için parola doğrulama ekranına gidilir.
steps.expected: Parola giriş alanı 64 karakterlik girdiyi kabul eder.

steps.action: Kayıtlı 64 karakterlik parolanın tamamı girilir ve doğrulama yapılır.
steps.expected: Sistem parolanın son karakterlerini de dahil ederek tamamını kesmeden doğrular ve doğrulama başarılı olarak sonuçlanır.

test_cases.title: Blocklisted password rejection during representative password change
test_cases.preconditions: A valid company representative account exists with a current valid password.
test_cases.test_inputs: A password known to be in the NIST SP 800-63B-4 §3.1.1.2 blocklist (e.g., 'password123').
test_cases.assumptions: The system maintains an up-to-date blocklist compliant with NIST SP 800-63B-4 §3.1.1.2.

steps.action: Log in as the company representative.
steps.expected: The user is successfully authenticated and redirected to the profile or security settings page.

steps.action: Navigate to the password change section and enter the current password.
steps.expected: The current password field is accepted.

steps.action: Enter a blocklisted password (e.g., 'password123') as the new password and confirm it.
steps.expected: The system rejects the new password and displays an error message indicating that the password is too common or compromised.

steps.action: Verify the account's password status.
steps.expected: The account's password remains unchanged.

test_cases.title: Valid non-blocklisted password acceptance during representative password change
test_cases.preconditions: A valid company representative account exists with a current valid password.
test_cases.test_inputs: A strong, unique password not present in the NIST SP 800-63B-4 §3.1.1.2 blocklist.
test_cases.assumptions: The chosen test password meets all other complexity requirements (if any) and is not in the blocklist.

steps.action: Log in as the company representative.
steps.expected: The user is successfully authenticated.

steps.action: Navigate to the password change section and enter the current password.
steps.expected: The current password field is accepted.

steps.action: Enter a valid, non-blocklisted password as the new password and confirm it.
steps.expected: The system accepts the new password and displays a success message.

steps.action: Log out and log back in using the new password.
steps.expected: The user is successfully authenticated with the new password.

test_cases.title: Blocklisted password rejection during representative password establishment
test_cases.preconditions: A new company representative account is being created or initialized where a password must be set for the first time.
test_cases.test_inputs: A password known to be in the NIST SP 800-63B-4 §3.1.1.2 blocklist.
test_cases.assumptions: The system allows password establishment for new representatives and applies the same blocklist check as for password changes.

steps.action: Initiate the process to establish a password for a new company representative.
steps.expected: The system presents a form to set the initial password.

steps.action: Enter a blocklisted password (e.g., 'qwerty123') as the new password and confirm it.
steps.expected: The system rejects the password and displays an error message indicating that the password is too common or compromised.

steps.action: Verify that the account does not have a set password.
steps.expected: The account remains in a state where a password has not been successfully established.

test_cases.title: Tam parola bloklistede yoksa kabul edilir
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcı şifre değiştirme ekranındadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Bloklistede tam olarak bulunmayan, ancak bloklistede yer alan bir kelimeyi içeren yeni parola (örn. 'Güvenli2024!').
test_cases.assumptions: Bloklistede 'Güvenli' kelimesi tek başına veya başka kombinasyonlarda mevcut olabilir, ancak 'Güvenli2024!' tam eşleşmesi yoktur.

steps.action: Bloklistede tam olarak bulunmayan, ancak bloklistede yer alan bir kelimeyi içeren yeni parola girilir ve kaydedilir.
steps.expected: Sistem parolayı kabul eder ve şifre güncellenir.

test_cases.title: Tam parola bloklistede varsa reddedilir
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcı şifre değiştirme ekranındadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Bloklistede tam olarak bulunan bir parola (örn. 'password123').
test_cases.assumptions: 'password123' ifadesi sistem bloklistesinde tam olarak mevcuttur.

steps.action: Bloklistede tam olarak bulunan parola girilir ve kaydedilir.
steps.expected: Sistem parolayı reddeder ve 'Bu parola kullanılamaz' veya benzeri bir hata mesajı gösterir.

test_cases.title: Bloklistede olan alt dize tam parolada yoksa kabul edilir
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcı şifre değiştirme ekranındadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Bloklistede 'admin' kelimesi varken, 'myadminuser99' parolası.
test_cases.assumptions: Bloklistede 'admin' var, ancak 'myadminuser99' tam olarak yok.

steps.action: Bloklistede yer alan bir alt dizeyi içeren ancak tam olarak bloklistede bulunmayan parola girilir.
steps.expected: Sistem parolayı kabul eder, çünkü karşılaştırma tam parola üzerinden yapılır.

test_cases.title: Blocklisted password rejection with reason
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account is in the password creation or change state.
test_cases.test_inputs: A password known to be on the system's blocklist (e.g., 'Password123').
test_cases.assumptions: The system maintains a blocklist of common or compromised passwords as per NIST SP 800-63B-4.

steps.action: Enter a password that is present on the blocklist into the password field.
steps.expected: The system rejects the password and displays a specific error message stating the reason for rejection (e.g., 'Password is too common' or 'Password is on the blocklist').

steps.action: Verify that the password field is cleared or allows re-entry.
steps.expected: The user is able to select and enter a different password.

test_cases.title: Acceptance of non-blocklisted password
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account is in the password creation or change state.
test_cases.test_inputs: A strong, unique password that is not on the blocklist.
test_cases.assumptions: The chosen password meets all other complexity requirements defined by the system.

steps.action: Enter a password that is not on the blocklist and meets other complexity criteria.
steps.expected: The system accepts the password without displaying a blocklist-related rejection message.

test_cases.title: Guidance displayed after blocklist rejection
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account is active. The password blocklist is configured.
test_cases.test_inputs: A password known to be on the blocklist (e.g., 'password123').
test_cases.assumptions: The blocklist contains common weak passwords.

steps.action: Navigate to the password change or registration screen for a company representative.
steps.expected: The password input field is visible.

steps.action: Enter a password that is on the blocklist.
steps.expected: The system rejects the password and displays an error message indicating it is on the blocklist.

steps.action: Observe the interface for guidance on choosing a strong password.
steps.expected: Guidance on choosing a strong password is displayed, consistent with NIST SP 800-63B-4 §3.1.1.2 recommendations.

test_cases.title: Guidance not displayed for valid password
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account is active.
test_cases.test_inputs: A strong password not on the blocklist.

steps.action: Navigate to the password change or registration screen.
steps.expected: The password input field is visible.

steps.action: Enter a strong password that is not on the blocklist.
steps.expected: The system accepts the password (or proceeds to confirmation) without displaying blocklist-specific rejection guidance.

test_cases.title: Password manager autofill functionality on login page
test_cases.preconditions: A registered company representative account exists. A password manager is installed and configured in the test browser.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid company representative credentials stored in the password manager.
test_cases.assumptions: The browser supports standard HTML5 autofill attributes (autocomplete, name) and the password manager is set to auto-fill on the portal domain.

steps.action: Navigate to the company representative login page.
steps.expected: The password input field is visible and focused or ready for input.

steps.action: Trigger the password manager autofill feature for the saved credentials.
steps.expected: The password manager successfully populates the password field without the portal blocking or clearing the input.

steps.action: Submit the login form.
steps.expected: The system accepts the autofilled password and logs the user in successfully.

test_cases.title: Password manager autofill functionality on password change page
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative is logged in. A password manager is installed and configured in the test browser.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new strong password generated and stored by the password manager.
test_cases.assumptions: The password change page includes fields for 'New Password' and 'Confirm New Password' that support autofill.

steps.action: Navigate to the password change page.
steps.expected: The 'New Password' and 'Confirm New Password' fields are visible.

steps.action: Use the password manager to autofill the 'New Password' field.
steps.expected: The password manager populates the field without the portal preventing the action.

steps.action: Use the password manager to autofill the 'Confirm New Password' field with the same value.
steps.expected: The password manager populates the field without the portal preventing the action.

steps.action: Submit the password change form.
steps.expected: The system accepts the new password and confirms the change.

test_cases.title: Password field does not disable autofill attributes
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists.
test_cases.test_inputs: None
test_cases.assumptions: The portal uses standard HTML input elements for password fields.

steps.action: Inspect the HTML source of the password input field on the login page.
steps.expected: The input field does not have the 'autocomplete' attribute set to 'off' or 'new-password' in a way that explicitly blocks standard password manager integration, and does not use JavaScript to prevent paste or autofill events.

steps.action: Inspect the HTML source of the password input field on the password change page.
steps.expected: The input field does not have the 'autocomplete' attribute set to 'off' or 'new-password' in a way that explicitly blocks standard password manager integration, and does not use JavaScript to prevent paste or autofill events.

test_cases.title: Recovery via two codes from different methods
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account with AAL2 authentication is locked or in recovery mode. Two valid recovery codes generated by different methods (e.g., SMS and Email) are available.
test_cases.test_inputs: Two valid recovery codes from different channels.
test_cases.assumptions: The system supports at least two distinct recovery code generation methods.

steps.action: Initiate the account recovery process for the company representative account.
steps.expected: The system presents options for recovery, including the option to use two recovery codes.

steps.action: Select the option to recover using two recovery codes.
steps.expected: The system prompts for the first recovery code.

steps.action: Enter the first valid recovery code obtained via the first method.
steps.expected: The system accepts the first code and prompts for the second recovery code.

steps.action: Enter the second valid recovery code obtained via a different method.
steps.expected: The system verifies both codes, confirms they are from different methods, and allows the user to reset their credentials or regain access.

test_cases.title: Recovery via one code and bound authenticator
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account with AAL2 authentication is in recovery mode. One valid recovery code is available. A single-factor authenticator (e.g., TOTP app or hardware token) is bound to the account.
test_cases.test_inputs: One valid recovery code and a valid authenticator code.
test_cases.assumptions: The account has a bound single-factor authenticator configured.

steps.action: Initiate the account recovery process.
steps.expected: The system presents recovery options, including 'One recovery code plus authenticator'.

steps.action: Select the option to recover using one recovery code and a bound authenticator.
steps.expected: The system prompts for the recovery code.

steps.action: Enter the valid recovery code.
steps.expected: The system accepts the code and prompts for the authenticator code.

steps.action: Enter the current valid code from the bound single-factor authenticator.
steps.expected: The system verifies the authenticator code and allows the user to reset their credentials or regain access.

test_cases.title: Recovery via repeated identity proofing
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account with AAL2 authentication is in recovery mode. The user has access to the identity proofing documents and methods required by NIST SP 800-63B-4 §4.2.2.2.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid identity proofing data (e.g., government ID, biometric match, or other specified proofing factors).
test_cases.assumptions: The system implements the specific identity proofing steps defined in NIST SP 800-63B-4 §4.2.2.2.

steps.action: Initiate the account recovery process.
steps.expected: The system presents recovery options, including 'Repeated identity proofing'.

steps.action: Select the option to recover via repeated identity proofing.
steps.expected: The system initiates the identity proofing workflow as specified in NIST SP 800-63B-4 §4.2.2.2.

steps.action: Complete the required identity proofing steps (e.g., upload ID, answer security questions, biometric verification).
steps.expected: The system validates the identity proofing data.

steps.action: Submit the completed identity proofing information.
steps.expected: The system confirms successful identity verification and allows the user to reset their credentials or regain access.

test_cases.title: Recovery rejected with two codes from the same method
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account with AAL2 authentication is in recovery mode. Two valid recovery codes generated by the same method (e.g., both via SMS) are available.
test_cases.test_inputs: Two valid recovery codes from the same channel.
test_cases.assumptions: The system can distinguish the source method of each recovery code.

steps.action: Initiate the account recovery process and select the option to use two recovery codes.
steps.expected: The system prompts for the first recovery code.

steps.action: Enter the first valid recovery code obtained via SMS.
steps.expected: The system accepts the first code and prompts for the second recovery code.

steps.action: Enter the second valid recovery code also obtained via SMS.
steps.expected: The system rejects the recovery attempt, indicating that the two codes must be obtained from different methods.

test_cases.title: Recovery rejected with invalid recovery code
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account with AAL2 authentication is in recovery mode.
test_cases.test_inputs: An invalid or expired recovery code.

steps.action: Initiate the account recovery process and select the option to use two recovery codes.
steps.expected: The system prompts for the first recovery code.

steps.action: Enter an invalid or expired recovery code.
steps.expected: The system rejects the code and displays an error message indicating the code is invalid or expired.

test_cases.title: Recovery rejected with unbound authenticator
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account with AAL2 authentication is in recovery mode. One valid recovery code is available. The account does not have a bound single-factor authenticator.
test_cases.test_inputs: One valid recovery code and a code from an unbound authenticator.
test_cases.assumptions: The system checks if the authenticator is bound to the account.

steps.action: Initiate the account recovery process and select the option to use one recovery code and a bound authenticator.
steps.expected: The system prompts for the recovery code.

steps.action: Enter the valid recovery code.
steps.expected: The system accepts the code and prompts for the authenticator code.

steps.action: Enter a code from an authenticator that is not bound to the account.
steps.expected: The system rejects the recovery attempt, indicating that the authenticator is not bound to the account.

test_cases.title: Disabling multiple authenticators after threshold reached
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with password and a second factor (e.g., TOTP) enabled. The account is not currently locked or disabled.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid username, incorrect password, incorrect second factor code.
test_cases.assumptions: The threshold for failed attempts defined in VBP Software Design Document §14 is 5 consecutive failures.

steps.action: Attempt login with the valid username, an incorrect password, and an incorrect second factor code.
steps.expected: Authentication fails. The system records the failure for both the password and the second factor authenticators.

steps.action: Repeat the failed login attempt with incorrect password and incorrect second factor code until the threshold (5 attempts) is reached.
steps.expected: After the 5th failed attempt, the system disables both the password authenticator and the second factor authenticator for the account.

steps.action: Attempt login with the valid username, the correct password, and the correct second factor code.
steps.expected: Authentication is rejected because the authenticators are disabled. The user is informed that the account requires administrative intervention or reset.

test_cases.title: Disabling authenticators when threshold is reached with mixed failures
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with password and a second factor (e.g., TOTP) enabled. The account is not currently locked or disabled.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid username, incorrect password, correct second factor code, incorrect second factor code.
test_cases.assumptions: The threshold for failed attempts defined in VBP Software Design Document §14 is 5 consecutive failures. The system tracks failures per authenticator involved in the consecutive sequence.

steps.action: Attempt login with the valid username, an incorrect password, and a correct second factor code.
steps.expected: Authentication fails due to the incorrect password. The system records a failure for the password authenticator.

steps.action: Attempt login with the valid username, a correct password, and an incorrect second factor code.
steps.expected: Authentication fails due to the incorrect second factor. The system records a failure for the second factor authenticator.

steps.action: Continue attempting logins with a mix of incorrect password and incorrect second factor codes until the total consecutive failed attempts reach the threshold (5).
steps.expected: After the 5th consecutive failed attempt, the system disables all authenticators involved in the consecutive failed sequence (both password and second factor).

steps.action: Attempt login with the valid username, the correct password, and the correct second factor code.
steps.expected: Authentication is rejected because the authenticators are disabled.

test_cases.title: No disabling when threshold is not reached
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with password and a second factor (e.g., TOTP) enabled. The account is not currently locked or disabled.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid username, incorrect password, incorrect second factor code.
test_cases.assumptions: The threshold for failed attempts defined in VBP Software Design Document §14 is 5 consecutive failures.

steps.action: Attempt login with the valid username, an incorrect password, and an incorrect second factor code 4 times consecutively.
steps.expected: Authentication fails each time. The system records the failures but does not disable any authenticators.

steps.action: Attempt login with the valid username, the correct password, and the correct second factor code.
steps.expected: Authentication succeeds. The user logs in successfully.

test_cases.title: Rebinding a disabled authenticator to the company representative account
test_cases.preconditions: An authenticator has been disabled due to reaching the failed-attempt threshold defined in VBP SDD §14. A valid company representative account exists.
test_cases.test_inputs: Credentials for the company representative account and the disabled authenticator.
test_cases.assumptions: The failed-attempt threshold is defined in VBP SDD §14. The rebinding process follows NIST SP 800-63B-4 §4.1 and VBP SDD §3.2.2.

steps.action: Attempt to use the disabled authenticator for authentication without rebinding it.
steps.expected: The system rejects the authenticator and indicates that it is disabled.

steps.action: Initiate the rebinding process for the disabled authenticator to the company representative account as specified in §3.2.2.
steps.expected: The system accepts the rebinding request and associates the authenticator with the company representative account.

steps.action: Attempt to use the rebound authenticator for authentication.
steps.expected: The system accepts the authenticator and allows the authentication process to proceed.

test_cases.title: Rebinding a disabled authenticator to an incorrect account
test_cases.preconditions: An authenticator has been disabled due to reaching the failed-attempt threshold defined in VBP SDD §14. A valid company representative account and a different user account exist.
test_cases.test_inputs: Credentials for the different user account and the disabled authenticator.
test_cases.assumptions: The system enforces that the authenticator must be bound to the company representative account specifically, as per §3.2.2.

steps.action: Initiate the rebinding process for the disabled authenticator to the different user account.
steps.expected: The system rejects the rebinding request because the authenticator must be bound to the company representative account.

steps.action: Attempt to use the authenticator for authentication with the different user account.
steps.expected: The system rejects the authenticator as it is not bound to the correct account.

test_cases.title: Request handling when e-Devlet response fails IAL requirement
test_cases.preconditions: VBP is configured to require a specific IAL level. A mock e-Devlet service is available to return responses with varying assurance levels.
test_cases.test_inputs: A valid citizen request that triggers an e-Devlet call. The mock e-Devlet service is configured to return a response with an IAL level lower than the VBP requirement.
test_cases.assumptions: The 'defined mechanism' for handling insufficient assurance is configured to decline the request and display a specific error message to the user.

steps.action: Submit a valid citizen request to VBP that requires e-Devlet verification.
steps.expected: VBP initiates a call to the e-Devlet service.

steps.action: The mock e-Devlet service returns a response indicating an IAL level below the VBP requirement.
steps.expected: VBP detects the insufficient IAL level.

steps.action: Observe the VBP response to the citizen.
steps.expected: VBP declines the request and displays a message indicating that the identity assurance level is insufficient, preventing further processing of the request.

test_cases.title: Request handling when e-Devlet response fails AAL requirement
test_cases.preconditions: VBP is configured to require a specific AAL level. A mock e-Devlet service is available to return responses with varying assurance levels.
test_cases.test_inputs: A valid citizen request that triggers an e-Devlet call. The mock e-Devlet service is configured to return a response with an AAL level lower than the VBP requirement.
test_cases.assumptions: The 'defined mechanism' for handling insufficient assurance is configured to decline the request and display a specific error message to the user.

steps.action: Submit a valid citizen request to VBP that requires e-Devlet verification.
steps.expected: VBP initiates a call to the e-Devlet service.

steps.action: The mock e-Devlet service returns a response indicating an AAL level below the VBP requirement.
